# FROM THE DESK OF NEWT GINGRICH
---
| | Dear Fellow Conservative, **I’m pleased to share with you that The New York Sun is now carrying my exclusive weekly column.**

In it, I'll weigh in on the most pressing matters facing our country – and there are many.

**Under the Biden administration, our nation has lost its way.** Many politicians and major institutions are corrupt. Leading corporations are following their lead.

But it’s the corruption of the media that has me most concerned. In my 70-year career in American politics, I’ve never seen it so bad. For this reason, I’ve chosen The New York Sun as a partner.

It’s a paper that shines like a beacon amid a sea of lies and misinformation. It has done so for nearly 200 years.

**It’s a patriotic paper that lives and breathes American values.** It places our Constitution front and center and has long been among its most valiant defenders.

It remains our nation’s most effective counterweight to The New York Times, which has bizarrely claimed the title of “paper of record” but speaks for so few of our fellow citizens.

Now more than ever, the battle for the future of our nation starts with the restoration of real American journalism, and The New York Sun is devoted to that mission. It truly "shines for all."

But I know what the Sun is up against. All the cards are stacked against us.

To win, we need you to join us. To join The New York Sun is to join the movement to save America.

**Membership starts at just 1 cent per day.**

In it, I'll weigh in on the most pressing matters facing our country – and there are many. Under the Biden administration, our nation has lost its way. Many politicians and major institutions are corrupt. Leading corporations are following their lead. But it’s the corruption of the media that has me most concerned. In my 70-year career in American politics, I’ve never seen it so bad. For this reason, I’ve chosen The New York Sun as a partner. It’s a paper that shines like a beacon amid a sea of lies and misinformation. It has done so for nearly 200 years. It’s a patriotic paper that lives and breathes American values. It places our Constitution front and center and has long been among its most valiant defenders. It remains our nation’s most effective counterweight to The New York Times, which has bizarrely claimed the title of “paper of record” but speaks for so few of our fellow citizens. Now more than ever, the battle for the future of our nation starts with the restoration of real American journalism, and The New York Sun is devoted to that mission. It truly "shines for all." But I know what the Sun is up against. All the cards are stacked against us. To win, we need you to join us. To join The New York Sun is to join the movement to save America. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

name: Alexandra Rojas
subject: Our impact on the Biden presidency
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

In this pivotal moment for Justice Democrats, I’m reflecting on all of the
ways people like YOU have empowered us to make a difference since our
inception in 2017.

Over the last six years, not only did we recruit and elect young, diverse,
working-class progressives like Summer Lee, Cori Bush, Jamaal Bowman, and
other Squad members to Congress — we made sure to fight for progressive
representation in President Joe Biden’s administration when we unseated
Donald Trump in 2020.

By hiring a Political Director and expanding our Communications team
earlier in the 2020 cycle, it helped us kick-start work with our allies on
the Hill and organize a progressive communications war room.

We didn’t waste a moment fighting for a seat at the table in the Biden
administration: just days after the 2020 presidential election, we
partnered with the Sunrise Movement to call on President Biden to appoint
progressive leaders to 13 executive positions.

Together, we also launched campaigns like ClimateMandate.org to hold
President Biden accountable to our communities and push for a bold
governing agenda on climate change, urging him to create a new office
dedicated to climate change.

Your support also allowed our team to combat the false narrative from
conservative Democrats that progressives were somehow to blame for losses
in the House and Senate, and push a positive vision forward of racial and
economic justice.

Though President Biden hasn’t been able to deliver every campaign promise
since he was elected, he came out swinging with many bold proposed actions
in his first 100 days of office, and ultimately passed historic
investments in infrastructure and the most aggressive action on climate
change and environmental justice in American history. That wouldn’t have
happened without our movement’s pressure.

Through our work with partners like Battle Born Collective, Data for
Progress, United We Dream, and New Deal Strategies, we put pressure on
Democrats in Congress to unite against the GOP by legislating
aggressively, centering democracy reform, and revising the rules (like
abolishing the filibuster) to pass big, bold, and popular solutions.

With the next presidential election approaching next year, our work is far
from over. The reality is that there is way more to do in order to deliver
the positive, lasting change our communities need and deserve. But with
unprecedented financial challenges and our refusal to accept corporate
money, the only way we’re going to be able to do that is through
grassroots support from people like you.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137970?refcode=em20230912-30829&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=30829%2E1203867%2E5nyjWi ]The future of Justice Democrats, the 2024 presidential election, our
democracy, and our country as we know it is in the hands of our grassroots
supporters. Please, if you can, pitch in $3 or more today to
fuel our fight ahead.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137976?refcode=em20230912-30829&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=30829%2E1203867%2E5nyjWi ]Contribute $3

We must come together to continue pushing President Biden and Congress to
deliver bold, progressive solutions for the people.

Thanks for all you do,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director, Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1021&akid=30829%2E1203867%2E5nyjWi ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1022&akid=30829%2E1203867%2E5nyjWi ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20230912-30829-footer&t=1023&refcode2=30829_1203867_5nyjWi&akid=30829%2E1203867%2E5nyjWi

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States. I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago – an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something – that we do love this country. I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A. I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I’m running for President because we have a country to save! I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor” because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. body:

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zjump7ru45hi8b8fhifm3hmnvh8jueh5k47odq00_rp22sh2s8i66p71cdg64o74c9h2bs)
Fellow American,

Over the last year, I've been honored to fight with everything I have to save women's sports. When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

I hope you saw my announcement on Hannity. I've partnered with the **Leadership Institute** to launch the [**_Riley Gaines Center._**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zjo8h05ei5j2uvvfov4vdnjdoo5p6sk6nlnf2u8g_rp22sh2s8i66p71cdg64o74c9h2bs)

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms. [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zq0gjvchpefh9laabhphrq3n6dbv2fmmf1gnk8g0_rp22sh2s8i66p71cdg64o74c9h2bs)
Through the Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2gt577cvil9n85k7j5n7haoue5l6t2d4a5krbk0_rp22sh2s8i66p71cdg64o74c9h2bs)**

You and I have the opportunity to build a movement to stand up for women's sports and common-sense American values. Not only will these young leaders help our country right now, they will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

Will you join me today and stand for truth?

[**By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zs3b63hvvfsh98t061354nb8k0co8sv6j61ttt30_rp22sh2s8i66p71cdg64o74c9h2bs)

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines

name: Bob Carlstrom
subject: Protect American sovereignty
body:
Your signature is needed in the next 48 hours on our “I SUPPORT H.R. 1546” petition

| |
---
| | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23539%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4RXndeS5mGCpTTpg4IAbzQ&sysid=1)
---
| | Your signature is needed in the next 48 hours on our “I SUPPORT H.R. 1546” petition I know that’s not a lot of time, but Congressman Ronny Jackson of Texas needs your signature on this petition to stop Joe Biden!
---
**SIGN THE PETITION**
---
| | Fellow Patriot, You know how the U.N.’s World Health Organization (WHO) schemed with Communist China to cover up the true origins of the COVID-19 pandemic. You know how this over-reaching, freedom-robbing body failed miserably to stop the spread of COVID-19. And you know that the World Health Organization’s gross misdeeds and incompetence led to the death of MILLIONS. **But what you probably don’t know is that Joe Biden is quietly negotiating a “treaty” with these unelected global bureaucrats to give them:** MORE of your money! MORE control over future pandemics! MORE power to control what America is allowed to do! _And Joe Biden wants to sneak this “treaty” through without even getting Senate approval!_
---
| | [**SIGN THE PETITION TO STOP JOE BIDEN AND THE WHO**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23530%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5b3c%2bFlICmwqxh7uK6yGQw&sysid=1)
---
| | H.R. 1546, the “Protecting American Sovereignty Act” was introduced by Congressman Ronny Jackson of Texas. And it’s the only bill in Congress that stops this freedom-robbing scheme by prohibiting even one penny of your tax dollars from funding it. This new WHO Global Pandemic “Treaty” is a direct threat to America’s sovereignty. It gives the WHO the power to declare and manage future global pandemic emergencies. And whenever the WHO declares a health emergency every nation that has signed on must submit to the WHO’s authority! The WHO will have authority over vaccine development, vaccine mandates, testing requirements, and even lockdown mandates and government surveillance! And not only does this terrible “treaty” give WHO all the power... **...it makes America pay BILLIONS for it!** This pandemic “treaty,” demands that the U.S. commits no less than 5% of our current health budget to WHO! **No thank you!** But Joe Biden has actually been negotiating with the WHO over the terms of their “treaty” for months. I don’t know if it’s because he’s in bed with the Chinese for whom this “treaty” is a boon... ...or if he just doesn’t know what he’s doing. Either way, informed and patriotic Americans like you and me must stop him before it’s too late. **That’s why you’re one of the first people to get this “I Support H.R. 1546” petition.** Because here’s the bottom line... With one stroke of his pen, Joe Biden can subject our nation to the power of globalists who hate America and everything we stand for. So I hope you see why your signature is so important in the next 48 hours. Congressman Ronny Jackson is standing up to Joe Biden and the one-world tyrants at the WHO. Congressman Jackson is a retired U.S. Navy Rear Admiral, the former White House Physician to President Trump, and now a proud member of Congress. He knows better than anyone how Joe Biden’s declining mental capacity threatens our national security. He knows that if Joe Biden signs this “treaty,” America will be at the mercy of the WHO and every other country that signed on -- countries like Communist China! I’m happy to report that 16 other Republicans also see the threat and have signed their name to H.R. 1546. And now we need you. **Please -- will you add your name to the “I Support H.R. 1546” petition right away and stop this treaty?** Once we receive your signature, I’ll make sure Congressman Jackson counts you as a supporter of H.R. 1546. The WHO has some powerful sway over Joe Biden but I’m hopeful we can beat them. After all, The Association for Mature American Citizens Action is the most influential advocacy group in the country when it comes to standing for the values of Conservative Seniors.
---
• We helped defeat the Democrats’ vote-stealing “For the People Act” by bombarding the Senate with hundreds of thousands of messages. • We helped pass election reform in state legislatures with the help of engaged local AMAC members in Kentucky, Arizona, Texas, Florida, and Pennsylvania. Legislation was signed into law in Kentucky, Arizona, and Florida. • In Florida, at the request of Governor Ron DeSantis’ office, your AMAC Action Team was right there at a key Florida State School Board meeting applying pressure to get Critical Race Theory voted OUT of Florida’s public-school curriculum. And so much more.
---
Our AMAC Action army of Conservative Seniors is getting things done. Now we’re facing one of our most important battles. If we don’t stop Joe Biden and this WHO Global Pandemic “Treaty,” unelected one-world bureaucrats will have more power in America than you and I do. And our sovereignty -- our freedom to determine our own future -- will be history. Thank you for your quick response in this matter. I know Congressman Jackson will be grateful when he sees the power of the AMAC Action army.
---
Sincerely,
---
Bob Carlstrom, President AMAC Action
---

name: Riley Gaines
subject: Join Me in Standing Up for Women’s Sports and American Values
body:
Over the last year, I’ve been honored to fight with everything I have to save women’s sports.

| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zmno1d0tqv7ce5dhq1miraafd99ofrj1s058a2sg_rp22sh2s8i66p71cdg66ob2c3h2bs)
Fellow American,

Over the last year, I've been honored to fight with everything I have to save women's sports. When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

I hope you saw my announcement on Hannity. I've partnered with the **Leadership Institute** to launch the [**_Riley Gaines Center._**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2ztdfr40n04uf0jmlsfob07r67cqokr2ms8kqn610_rp22sh2s8i66p71cdg66ob2c3h2bs)

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms. [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zdbunfrkpudlg2tq6ig5pjrn9enh2ofss9ete8hg_rp22sh2s8i66p71cdg66ob2c3h2bs)
Through the Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zm8demtqsepmdoflpc9nei7b5s4sfeskbpphcl50_rp22sh2s8i66p71cdg66ob2c3h2bs)**

You and I have the opportunity to build a movement to stand up for women's sports and common-sense American values. Not only will these young leaders help our country right now, they will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

Will you join me today and stand for truth?

[**By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z1o1u82dgo2ja44792c2qtnn95cv8ar83las5jpg_rp22sh2s8i66p71cdg66ob2c3h2bs)

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines

The Riley Gaines Center

at the Leadership Institute

## House Launches Formal Impeachment Inquiry
House Speaker Kevin McCarthy announced [a formal impeachment inquiry](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFutDAQhJ_GdEb2rs9AQfFLv-guSpcS-ezl2AQwsZ278PYRqVONNCONPn1v1_HqeOHt_uJW6ssUR-cLP2hUndQoAUeoQj8RAWFFvbadsapRqqvmPjhQOhhvvEdtTdMFcuEGBqYWW7BQcQ8KUHUaVXe5aKyha00bJrSkVNMqFEZR4BJT_R55KzNNyxEflGof12rp51L2LPCfgEHA4G5-o2eu7_GcBQyvceHCPgsY8k7ug5JcvXepzIek7518oSBpCzFlkrzu5Py80lYkb59fnA65J8oczuZ2xvlTYjoEDhwE_tcKtTYWbJX6sD95WTjbRhh1Xx0vv4zlb2U_AQAA__-mJ24f) into President Joe Biden, citing the need to investigate allegations of "abuse of power, obstruction and corruption." House Oversight Committee Chairman James Comer will lead the inquiry, a first step toward deciding whether to bring impeachment charges. House GOP leaders [will meet tomorrow](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLuSozAQRb8GMlFNS7wCgk3IvOmGlBAt02s9WEk267-f8sQT3ap7klPnz229aXYc7r-1p7nYuGpT-EUrTKKVAuWK9T5bIiRZ09z2k-phAJjqY27HQXWotdm7jUbQSqGapAE0m91oxJpnBJQwtRKmrmtlg9Ooxt3KngCGEWSlgHYuMTV_I4dykHXv-KLUmOhrNx-lnLmSvypcKlyu62ps_B_oyh9e4XJGx4VNrnA54jOTyCfpByXxoBcH4Y3RqRxvoUOIz2AoCxuT106wP0mbw1MogsO_J6e3OBNl3j_P9pk6zft5sXOc-6FScPea3bdX-TnTVwAAAP__Y0ttGg) to lay out their latest findings and the status of the Biden investigation. The White House called the inquiry "a wild goose chase," and House Democrats said they would [defend Biden](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLuO6yAUAL_G7ogObygobpMut93SwnAIrDBYNkmUv19l6y1H04zm67bcfKml3f_7Dd1IffFhlCcuYAnlhPGFzdElRIZ8RkeVFQo0gJ2zS96i1lImyUGBkYpLJaj2OmivNaa5OAaMg6UcrJSUX5g1wsTEFQJoA3wSgLGMfly-e2kjY6rv_sTjEvo2V5fH2M-J_5vYdWJXvzd8nR_1gWOUUHFi1y0Ef4z8JmuJ2EjZdvQhb9gGOfNjxP5qJPfHieTA_bHWEnw7yUqNZsBWNIaKpH1YY1TI0HKNjEcxHy7ur1JrOZWeBNw3X-pv1vj70k8AAAD__0kjaD0) "until the very end."
## Death Toll Could Hit 10,000 in Libya Flooding
Massive flooding in Libya has left [more than 5,000 dead](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFvwyAUBOBfY29YD7CNGRi6eEvXjtYLPGIqDBHQWPn3lTt3OZ30Laf7um03DDGkxyceZJrPG9oWXrSBZlwyITfRO-OJBMmeDJ_1OIMC0P1uFOek5TJbrma1gOcoJan7RNbyER3vgxEgJGguQU8Tl4PQy7g4L2cCUAvIbgRyoeUyfOeQ2k4-vvOLymDz0Uezt_asnfzoxNqJ9TzPId1torNe3on1qhfkEl0n1hjub2Q-5uwqa3v-qZhcZZ6wkGOO8IqSkDk8KrM5RnxWYsUm5DBOau6Lcc8zxBjqrLoRHgeG-Lel_X_NbwAAAP__LIllng) and at least 10,000 missing after dams collapsed and whole neighborhoods were swept away by Mediterranean storm Daniel. Floods wiped out a quarter of [the coastal city of Derna](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuhDAQRL_GdEbLmsO4cJGG7tKmRMZeHxsZfDLOofv7iNQpZ0YavZmv-3x3nHh_fLqNbI15dr7yi2YwslMS1YxNsJEISTVku8H0A2gA06x2XAyiCjEsXjs13oa-98r1etE6are4hi0CKjCdAnO7dapFM_ZjiGogAD2CEj1Q4JpL-515ryvF9M4vKq3PW5PsWuvzEOpD4CRwOs-zLfRTqRxXfjm5pCBwcrGwdwKnLReSdXW77ABALjkwHbKQv0opyMTL2-3Sc31LFysVGVPO4ZAb73xc-gKW13YUODXFhufJKfExaNHDY3Oc_tjq_1f9BgAA___gl2op), with many families being washed into the sea. Aid in the form of rescue boats, generators, and food was being rushed to Libya's aid. The U.S. Special Envoy for Libya issued an [official declaration of humanitarian need](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu5CAQgOGngY7VMGBjCopr3O21V1qsGZs5YVjZZKN9-yipU__FL33_7ss9cuG6_40Hhb61Ja6dX7SAV9ooNAvKFDYiJCMp6NHbERyAlzlgtNNo3AAAw-pddA9at4dGXBGd1SA5IKABrw34YdDmhn6yU9rMSABuAiMsUOLeztv_xrVn2sq7vei8re2QJeTen5cwfwTOAueeKXMp303g_GyF17fAmWuns8bOrcYicLba-0F7dbSTVM-xKgQAlSgm1XP7uGJNlzr4urjuiqsq_HhHtZXWEtdd4CzPkJ6fXApfoxMW9iPyz1b234W-AgAA___6FWZv), saying the order would free up funding from the United States to support relief efforts.
## Aaron Rodgers' Injury Ends His Season
It's been confirmed that superstar quarterback Aaron Rodgers [tore his Achilles tendon](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uwyAYAJ8Gb1gfPyYwMHTxlq4dLQofMREBC2jcvn2Vzp1uuOGk-7huV5dyKrd390A7Yt2cH-mJGxjKBOVi41OwEZGjmNAyZaSCC4CZdiu8XmBR4BcA-DRMeQxRMtQCHXAtp2Q5cAGGCTDLwsTMjZY6RKEQ4KJBEAkY0qhtvtdUxo4x_9QnttnXx5TtPsbRiXgjfCV8Pc9zjvW74NlfnvC1H7WNTvh6x9Gpc60W2mq4Yeu0f8X44qitUOf3lDN22tH1WqZmw3GmnFNXFyLh9nAp_zXH_wt-AwAA__8TR15U) on live TV Monday night, putting him out for the season and abruptly ending his much-anticipated role as savior of the New York Jets. The injury came on the fourth play of "Monday Night Football," less than 10 minutes into the game. Announcers, including Peyton and Eli Manning, were stunned at the sudden turnabout ([See Video](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGuozAQheGnMZ2RGRsSCopt3GXbLZFjj2GyxoOMN4i3X-Xe9vafdI7-P4_54ShRXn67DacaeXa-0htnNcpOS9AzNGGKiIC6wakbRjOom1Jjs07PoKPzT9cP4DszKINRg-t9xMF0JpqGJlCg1dhpNfZ9p1sY7-Yeoh5QqdtdaWEUBqpc2hdTrivGdPEbS-t5a9K01rofQv8SYAXY8zzbwv7vVXmnfFD4dgLsZ0WAVaMA24EAu3K6pOdT7nhVznJzOVNeZEHn6yErS-cKZ1k4LFgOSfn1r1zyIzkHd8lMy1plZK5Pl5IA25Qp7CelRMdwE0Ytm6P0dbP-XO1_AAAA___ULG-O)). ---
Friend, are you concerned your vote might not count in this coming presidential election? I know I am. In the past two elections we've seen rampant voter fraud cancel out the votes of conservatives across the country. We must stop the cheating. And we must do it soon. Friend, that's why Election Integrity is AMAC Action's #1 priority ahead of the 2024 presidential election. **[Will you help us?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=27d320eae51445869333d71cbec9c1f0&_e=cXKtnWCsOGFjI7nr8-1b5trB0BcAzotox4hyNvhBmg0iaBH41ZD5hbzg34qOOqDDHzsdN3EzSuf_wzk6d3G4WFERSQBlYv9Ig-uSaysfAVbpekH0np7CU9P6jNPj8OHNk3w3MqMclshl23q13TX26rCbbLRFgUMzdLBcG3RJM7kJO68RguafES9EfA_yhuzC9rVBdvkmJja2MsNuhpzCoZ9_uaix6E83LglCp-Q_PpXypI-_vQph75h2b4l6WwgoIX7hdWsQ6FCsxhlCpgnHdEakGCEfhcvtXfcA69WHss_nFGB-tJoF63kGJWsuLfRo05ranKE6DTxDkB8v7a65BQ%3D%3D)** Because it's about time conservatives had a fair chance at beating the Obama-Biden regime once and for all. That's why you and I need to stand up and act now if we want to restore and protect the integrity of our elections. I'm talking common sense voting reforms. **_NO mass, unverified voting from home ..._**** _ _** **_No remote drop boxes ...._** **_No vote harvesting ..._** **_No manipulation of the vulnerable elderly voters in nursing homes ...._** **_NO extended registration deadlines ..._**** _ _** **_And NO counting late ballots AFTER the polls have closed. _****_ _** **[If you stand with me, I need you to make a special contribution of $24 to secure our elections immediately.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=27d320eae51445869333d71cbec9c1f0&_e=cXKtnWCsOGFjI7nr8-1b5trB0BcAzotox4hyNvhBmg0iaBH41ZD5hbzg34qOOqDDHzsdN3EzSuf_wzk6d3G4WFERSQBlYv9Ig-uSaysfAVbpekH0np7CU9P6jNPj8OHNk3w3MqMclshl23q13TX26rCbbLRFgUMzdLBcG3RJM7kJO68RguafES9EfA_yhuzCQxGBLRm9wNYkgZr6xtzwCQRSFEY-c0QgrNI7TPeoZQsv_thU8PyXGZ3FAOQNiD3qyh4TyUcaCAGj5e5vtK9RLYS9TbjnYrxH8zZCnR1lEsCiZqlpHE2PZpCzfgDWPSraYXJQzeRmj-Ktn8trMdVyaw%3D%3D) ** Friend, my name is Bob Carlstrom - President of AMAC Action. You may have heard of AMAC Action before - we're the #1 most influential advocacy group in the country when it comes to standing for the values of conservative seniors like you. If you've ever heard of AMAC Action, you may know that unlike the left-leaning AARP, we've been fighting AGAINST "Obamacare", AGAINST "Medicare for All," and AGAINST all of these radical schemes to "transform" America. That's why we have 33 chapters and 328 delegates fighting to preserve and protect our Constitution and our traditional values and heritage. AMAC Action and its volunteer advocates pound on the doors of every member of the U.S. House of Representatives and the U.S. Senate to fight for you. Friend, I'm reaching out to you today because we only have one year to make sure our elections are secure for the 2024 presidential election. body:

| | **Dear Friend,** | **Hunting season begins this week. Act now and donate $27 to help protect wolves and the planet from greedy interests!** _If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | [Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1981536?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

---
This is urgent, so I’ll get straight to the point. Hunting season starts this week in many Northern Rockies states. These lands are home to majestic wolves. And right now, _only 6,000 wolves remain in the lower 48 states._ But trophy hunters are about to start gunning them down for “fun.” For many wolves, this fall could be their last. And soon, we could lose wolves forever. **Unless we act now. [Rush your $27 donation now and help us reach our $3,230 goal to protect wolves and the planet before time runs out.](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1981540?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
This fall and winter could be devastating for wolves, Friend. Not even wolves in Yellowstone are safe. That’s because they aren’t bound by park lines. And the states surrounding Yellowstone have limited safeguards to protect them. So the moment a Yellowstone wolf sets a paw outside of the park, it’s fair game for the vicious hunters lurking in the woods.
But Yellowstone can’t afford to lose any more wolves. Just last year, a trophy hunting rampage **wiped out an entire Yellowstone wolf pack.** Now, there are only 89 gray wolves left in the park. And to make matters worse, trophy hunters and Big Polluters are fighting tooth and nail to strip away the few protections wolves still have.
That’s why this hunting season, it’s more important than ever to protect these iconic canines from a gruesome fate. There’s still time to act before we lose wolves forever. But if we want to win, we need members like you standing with us. **So please, will you join us in this fight today before hunting season takes an irreversible toll on wolves and the planet?**
**We need immediate action to protect wolves and the planet. Donate $27 today and help us reach our $3,230 goal before midnight tonight!**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1981536?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate $50 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1981537?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate $100 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1981538?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate another amount](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1981539?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
We’ve seen the devastating impacts of hunting season before. Last season, hunters gunned down _**over 250 helpless wolves**_ across the Montana. But these precious canines can’t afford another hunting season like this.
That’s because one wolf kill isn’t just one wolf kill. When a mama wolf is gunned down by a trophy hunter, her babies’ chances for survival plummet. Without protection, orphaned wolf pups could**starve or freeze** to death. Or they might survive long enough to fall prey to other animals and trophy hunters.
And trophy hunters don’t just kill wolves. They make them suffer using inhumane methods like**neck snares** and **steel traps.** Wolves are left _**reeling in pain for days**_ before dying. These devastating scenes could soon become common as hunting season looms.
No animal deserves this fate, Friend. But if we don’t act soon, it could get even easier for hunters to viciously torture and kill wolves in droves. That’s because Big Polluters are using their massive influence to help trophy hunters strip away the last few protections wolves still have. If they get their way, they could wipe out wolves. All so they can take over their lands and open them up for destructive mining and logging. That would also destroy any possibility of wolves being able to recover in the future.
Trophy hunters and Big Polluters have shown time and again that they care more about lining their pockets than the lives of wolves and survival of our planet. But Friend, **is private profit really worth all of this bloodshed and destruction?**
**Help stop the slaughter before wolves are lost forever. Rush your $27 donation now to help us reach our $3,230 goal for wolves and the planet. **
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1981536?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate $50 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1981537?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate $100 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1981538?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate another amount](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1981539?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Even one wolf loss is devastating, but losing wolves would have serious impacts on our planet. Wolves are a keystone species. They help balance out their ecosystems by keeping prey populations in check. Not to mention, scavengers rely on their kills to sustain them. Without wolves, other plant and animal species could suffer.
That’s why each death of this iconic species is a big deal. Since a recent rule rolled back federal protections for gray wolves in Northern Rockies states, the trophy hunting lobby has pushed for even more cruel and inhumane laws throughout wolves’ natural habitats. And even worse, **the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service could reinstate federal protections for these creatures -- but has still failed to do so!**
With hunting season around the corner, it’s never been more important to stand up for wolves. Friends of the Earth is working to put a stop to the violent attacks against the last surviving wolf packs and protect our planet. And that means protecting the Endangered Species Act. A vital piece of legislation, the ESA allows us to shield endangered and other species from violence. Even more, it gives us the power to block destructive industries like Big Oil, logging, and factory farming from destroying critical habitats for profit.
Your membership support can go a long way to fuel our efforts to uphold the ESA and protect our planet. But we’re up against some powerful foes. Private trophy-hunting interests and Big Polluters have seemingly bottomless resources to get their way. That’s why I’m asking for your help today. We are falling $1,034 short of our goal. But if just 1 in 12 people reading this makes a $27 membership contribution today, we can reach our $3,230 goal and make real change for wolves and the planet. Will you stand with us today?
**Stand up to greedy interests before we lose wolves forever. Donate $27 immediately to fight for wolves and the planet! **

[Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1981536?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Raena Garcia

subject: Here’s why I support an impeachment inquiry into Joe Biden
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY DAN CRENSHAW FOR CONGRESS
body:

| | | | | | |

|
---
| |
---
| Peter -
Yesterday, Speaker McCarthy announced the House of Representatives would open an impeachment inquiry into Joe Biden.
You're going to see a lot of hand wringing from the left and their allies in the media about this commonsense step, so I wanted to share my thoughts on this subject and why I support opening this inquiry.
Yes, it's reasonable to open an impeachment inquiry when a particularly suspicious set of facts has emerged that warrant further investigation. Let's review those facts:

1. Almost $20 million in payments were directed to Biden's associates and family through different shell companies, according to bank records.
2. The Treasury Department obtained more than 150 transactions involving the Bidens and other associates that were flagged by American banks as "suspicious activity."
3. There's eyewitness testimony that Joe Biden joined multiple phone calls and had conversations that resulted in cars and millions of dollars being given to Hunter Biden and his son's business partners.
4. Hunter Biden implicated his dad in conversations with CCP officials, with whom he was attempting to do business. A WhatsApp message from Hunter in 2017, obtained by the IRS, stated "I am sitting here with my father and we would like to understand why the commitment made has not been fulfilled." This was in regards to a $100,000 payment to Hunter from a suspected CCP official and businessman.
5. The White House story on this subject has changed multiple times, which only increases suspicions. First, they claimed that Joe Biden had no knowledge whatsoever of Hunter Biden's business dealings. And now, after facts have emerged that expose the obvious lie of their original claim, they are saying that Joe Biden was not *involved* in Hunter Biden's business. This rapid about-face in the White House's response raises serious concerns.

An impeachment inquiry will allow access to more documents that could highlight corruption or pay-for-play. It will provide the apex of investigative authority and is necessary for the House to perform proper oversight.
This inquiry will help House Republicans to get the facts. If you have nothing to hide, you shouldn't oppose a fact-finding mission.
I will keep you updated as this inquiry proceeds.

| | On September 4, campaign supporters from across the Commonwealth converged at the Emord residence for a pool party and cookout. It was great for us to get together, socialize,discuss the need for early voting, and enjoy great food on what was an incredibly beautiful day. On September 5, I had the privilege of speaking before the Loudoun County Republican Women’s Club. I am grateful for the support of so many wonderful LCRW patriots, past and present. Loudoun Republicans were indispensable to Governor Youngkin’s victory, and they will be indispensable to our victory as well.

name: Al Canata
subject: How Bidenomics affects you
body:
You may have heard about Bidenomics, but what does it really mean?

[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c676490%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YuYdMGKbFtUYi4CUiNKKnQ&sysid=1)

Friend,

You may have heard about Bidenomics, but what does it really mean? More importantly, what does it mean for the taxpayers and for our country?

**Bidenomics hasn’t increased jobs or decreased unemployment.** It's because people were going back to work after a once-in-a-generation pandemic. Bidenomics didn't decrease deficit spending by doing anything, either. The deficit is still a huge problem, and _many of Biden's policies have made it worse_.

What Bidenomics has brought us is -
* Rapid inflation due to the printing of money and more federal spending.
* Americans taking on a record amount of credit card debt.
* Families falling behind on their car and house payments, along with rising interest rates.

**This administration has not done a good job of looking out for middle-class Americans, and neither has Congress. **

I am Al Canata, Vice President of Strategic Partnerships at the National Taxpayers Union (NTU). We are the “Voice of America’s Taxpayers.” Our mission is to achieve favorable, pro-taxpayer policy outcomes using the most effective team on Capitol Hill and in the states.

My goal is to raise $20,000 before the end of the week to convince Congress to stop pushing Bidenomics on our country as lawmakers come back to Washington from their recess. [Your generous support helps NTU expose the issues with Bidenomics. Please click below to donate $10, $35, $50, or even $100 today.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c676491%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=GBJ0c9J%2fnNA5qfyueYIKwA&sysid=1)

[Donate >>](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c676492%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DuiABQrHpAx0WRHNZknX3w&sysid=1)

**Bidenomics is just another way to make people poor, and making people poor is not the best way to fight inflation.**

They are trying to combat inflation by destroying demand. The philosophy there is if people don't have money, they can't go out and buy stuff, which will reduce demand, and prices will fall.

If we keep seeing aggressive action from the Fed in the form of raising interest rates, things will only get worse.

**The Federal Reserve could cause a consumer debt spiral that leads to mass bankruptcies that could lead to a full-scale recession!**

Even though there is no easy solution, we need better responses out of Washington, D.C.

**You can help the National Taxpayers Union fight for policies that benefit taxpayers. Please click below to donate any amount today.**

[Donate $10 >>](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c676493%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=t0yIbx69JAO%2fXzW%2fzS9SMg&sysid=1)

[Donate $35 >>](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c676494%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3NNBUDKaTzPNjtcMbDrTdQ&sysid=1)

[Donate $50 >>](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c676405%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=h7nyW3xbcVnLU66DEktT5A&sysid=1)

[Donate $100 >>](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c676406%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2azKhcVbFqmTD35mg5PJyA&sysid=1)

[Donate $250 >>](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c676407%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=19jfhJSUtPJZHqogpSJOXg&sysid=1)

[Donate $500 >>](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c676408%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=pA9qLsGW4Ek7NIQ92j6yZw&sysid=1)

[Donate $1,000 >>](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c676409%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0EocxrxVklJyTGcl4ucgew&sysid=1)

[Donate Any Amount >>](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c676400%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xFgxxdmbrerTiffA6KMu8A&sysid=1)

If Bidenomics is going to lower prices, it needs to increase supply. That means -
* Cranking out more energy supply, _something Biden has been hostile towards_.

* Rewarding rather than punishing our manufacturing sector and making sure the government doesn’t stand in the way of building and expanding factories.

* Producing more agricultural products.Improving our trade policy and opening up foreign markets to make sure our manufacturers can sell things abroad.

* Getting federal spending back under control by making sure Congress follows through on the spending restraint in the recently passed Fiscal Responsibility Act.

* **Fixing our tax policy by reinstating NTU’s Tax Cut and Jobs Act** , which had a lot of good provisions that really got our economy cooking like never before.

It is critical that our businesses across the board continue to create jobs, raise wages, and succeed in a globally competitive environment. That will lower prices and make us all better off in the process.

[Will you support NTU‘s efforts to keep the Biden administration’s hand out of your pockets and boot from your back? Please click below to donate $10, $35, $50, or even $100 today.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c676401%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Q7i4XYrH15P1TkU4yHxfNg&sysid=1)

[Donate >>](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c676492%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DuiABQrHpAx0WRHNZknX3w&sysid=1)

Thank you,

Al Canata
Vice President of Strategic Partnerships
National Taxpayers Union

_NTU is a 501(c)(4) nonprofit, nonpartisan citizen group whose members work every day for lower taxes and smaller government at all levels._

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

name: Al Canata
subject: What's the deal with Bidenomics?
body:
You may have heard about Bidenomics, but what does it really mean?

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zl38u8qunukacfc6jafr3umr0uhnsmvkl56oor90_rp22sh2s8i66p71cdh61o32clh2bs)

Friend,

You may have heard about Bidenomics, but what does it really mean? More importantly, what does it mean for the taxpayers and for our country?

**Bidenomics hasn 't increased jobs or decreased unemployment.** It's because people were going back to work after a once-in-a-generation pandemic. Bidenomics didn't decrease deficit spending by doing anything, either. The deficit is still a huge problem, and _many of Biden 's policies have made it worse_.

What Bidenomics has brought us is -
* Rapid inflation due to the printing of money and more federal spending.
* Americans taking on a record amount of credit card debt.
* Families falling behind on their car and house payments, along with rising interest rates.

**This administration has not done a good job of looking out for middle-class Americans, and neither has Congress. **

I am Al Canata, Vice President of Strategic Partnerships at the National Taxpayers Union (NTU). We are the "Voice of America's Taxpayers." Our mission is to achieve favorable, pro-taxpayer policy outcomes using the most effective team on Capitol Hill and in the states.

My goal is to raise $20,000 before the end of the week to convince Congress to stop pushing Bidenomics on our country as lawmakers come back to Washington from their recess. [Your generous support helps NTU expose the issues with Bidenomics. Please click below to donate $10, $35, $50, or even $100 today.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z3esa6ck75a1qfeqvhij88kibeial143qj67e768_rp22sh2s8i66p71cdh61o32clh2bs)

[Donate >>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zi2567to11ts484abth211gkgp2ig07kda5ka5ho_rp22sh2s8i66p71cdh61o32clh2bs)

**Bidenomics is just another way to make people poor, and making people poor is not the best way to fight inflation.**

They are trying to combat inflation by destroying demand. The philosophy there is if people don't have money, they can't go out and buy stuff, which will reduce demand, and prices will fall.

If we keep seeing aggressive action from the Fed in the form of raising interest rates, things will only get worse.

**The Federal Reserve could cause a consumer debt spiral that leads to mass bankruptcies that could lead to a full-scale recession!**

Even though there is no easy solution, we need better responses out of Washington, D.C.

**You can help the National Taxpayers Union fight for policies that benefit taxpayers. Please click below to donate any amount today.**

If Bidenomics is going to lower prices, it needs to increase supply. That means -
* Cranking out more energy supply, _something Biden has been hostile towards_.

* Rewarding rather than punishing our manufacturing sector and making sure the government doesn't stand in the way of building and expanding factories.

* Producing more agricultural products.Improving our trade policy and opening up foreign markets to make sure our manufacturers can sell things abroad.

# Capitol Report
September 13, 2023
---
|
---
| **Missouri legislators return to Capitol for veto session**
The Missouri General Assembly will convene for its annual veto session on Sept. 13 with no serious efforts to override any of the governor’s vetoes expected. Gov. Mike Parson, a Republican, rejected just a single bill lawmakers enacted during their spring legislative session while issuing 179 line-item budget vetoes.

The governor’s budget actions struck $555.3 million in spending authority from the FY 2024 state budget. However, the remaining $51 billion budget still includes record-high state spending and is roughly $3 billion more than the $48 billion budget originally authorized for FY 2023.

Few of the budget vetoes were high-profile or controversial and many eliminated spending Parson did not request but that individual lawmakers added for the benefit of their districts. One of the more significant vetoes struck $28 million for improvements along Interstate 44. He also eliminated millions of dollars in state funding for a variety of local infrastructure projects around the state and rejected providing State Highway Patrol and Capitol Police officers with pay increases exceeding the 8.7 percent given to all state workers.

Reconsideration of the budget vetoes will begin in the House of Representatives. Although it’s expected some lawmakers will bring up for debate individual items affecting their communities, any override motions that are successful in the House aren’t anticipated to pass in the Senate.

Since Parson became governor in 2018, the House has voted to override nine of his line-item vetoes, but all of those efforts died in the Senate. A successful override requires the support of two-thirds supermajorities in the both chambers – 109 votes in the House and 23 in the Senate.

The only full bill Parson vetoed this year, Senate Bill 189, was a 142-page omnibus crime bill. Since the bulk of its provisions are in other legislation the governor signed into law, the Senate isn’t expected to consider overriding. However, several key provisions of SB 186 didn’t make it into law elsewhere, including those to create a statewide conviction review unit, crackdown on celebratory gunfire, streamline expungement proceedings and expand compensation for the wrongfully convicted. It also sought to make it a felony to harm a police dog, even if acting in self-defense in response to an illegal or unjustified attack ordered by the animal’s handler.

Although a veto session can last up to 10 days under the Missouri Constitution, they typically are over in a few hours. Last year’s veto session proved a rare exception, however, when shortly after it convened Republican legislative leaders unexpectedly recessed for eight days to continue negotiations over a special legislative session on tax cuts that was taking place around the same time. Lawmakers ultimately concluded the veto session with no override attempts.

clean_body: Missouri legislators return to Capitol for veto session | | | | | | | Capitol Report September 13, 2023 | | Missouri legislators return to Capitol for veto session The Missouri General Assembly will convene for its annual veto session on Sept. 13 with no serious efforts to override any of the governor’s vetoes expected. Gov. Mike Parson, a Republican, rejected just a single bill lawmakers enacted during their spring legislative session while issuing 179 line-item budget vetoes. The governor’s budget actions struck $555.3 million in spending authority from the FY 2024 state budget. However, the remaining $51 billion budget still includes record-high state spending and is roughly $3 billion more than the $48 billion budget originally authorized for FY 2023. Few of the budget vetoes were high-profile or controversial and many eliminated spending Parson did not request but that individual lawmakers added for the benefit of their districts. One of the more significant vetoes struck $28 million for improvements along Interstate 44. He also eliminated millions of dollars in state funding for a variety of local infrastructure projects around the state and rejected providing State Highway Patrol and Capitol Police officers with pay increases exceeding the 8.7 percent given to all state workers. Reconsideration of the budget vetoes will begin in the House of Representatives. Although it’s expected some lawmakers will bring up for debate individual items affecting their communities, any override motions that are successful in the House aren’t anticipated to pass in the Senate. Since Parson became governor in 2018, the House has voted to override nine of his line-item vetoes, but all of those efforts died in the Senate. A successful override requires the support of two-thirds supermajorities in the both chambers – 109 votes in the House and 23 in the Senate. The only full bill Parson vetoed this year, Senate Bill 189, was a 142-page omnibus crime bill. Since the bulk of its provisions are in other legislation the governor signed into law, the Senate isn’t expected to consider overriding. However, several key provisions of SB 186 didn’t make it into law elsewhere, including those to create a statewide conviction review unit, crackdown on celebratory gunfire, streamline expungement proceedings and expand compensation for the wrongfully convicted. It also sought to make it a felony to harm a police dog, even if acting in self-defense in response to an illegal or unjustified attack ordered by the animal’s handler. Although a veto session can last up to 10 days under the Missouri Constitution, they typically are over in a few hours. Last year’s veto session proved a rare exception, however, when shortly after it convened Republican legislative leaders unexpectedly recessed for eight days to continue negotiations over a special legislative session on tax cuts that was taking place around the same time. Lawmakers ultimately concluded the veto session with no override attempts. | | | | | | Keep In Touch Phone: Email: mailto:Steven.Roberts@house.mo.gov Office Address: Room 329 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright © 2023 Roberts for St. Louis, All rights reserved. |LIST:DESCRIPTION| Paid for by Roberts for St. Louis, James D. name: Ro Khanna
subject: TAKE ACTION: Show your support for auto workers
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

The United Auto Workers (UAW) are on the verge of launching one of the biggest strikes of the year, with nearly 150,000 workers calling for fair wages and better working conditions.

Let’s show the UAW we have their back–sign here to stand with auto workers and their families as they prepare to fight for the respect they deserve. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/uaw-petition?contactdata=Cs1EGQKyKNHL280dlwtwwCj0wIJ+RWfvLUVJ+Cd8Gp4/GtMG7LR4BwEpdEvTfg58zZfZmGLs8KRwBjAjAeDnOuv/aoaNyFJbU9ifrtko5YRWyHGm99MjFzq0suurmMGY1lta8cvK9g3gCbpdBHTGsg==]

Sign the Petition [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/uaw-petition?contactdata=Cs1EGQKyKNHL280dlwtwwCj0wIJ+RWfvLUVJ+Cd8Gp4/GtMG7LR4BwEpdEvTfg58zZfZmGLs8KRwBjAjAeDnOuv/aoaNyFJbU9ifrtko5YRWyHGm99MjFzq0suurmMGY1lta8cvK9g3gCbpdBHTGsg==]

Over the past fifteen years, it’s become harder and harder to make a career in car manufacturing. Newer hires are making significantly less [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-autos-usa-families/for-uaw-members-two-tier-wage-issue-is-personal-idUSKBN0OI0C420150602] than their coworkers for doing the same job under a tiered labor system. While jobs were cut in the wake of the Great Recession, remaining employees have been forced to work 60 to 70 hours per week [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2023/aug/21/uaw-big-three-automakers-union-contract-negotiations] and lost their pensions. Job security is on the line in new manufacturing jobs. Meanwhile, the CEOs of Ford, General Motors, and Stellantis (Chevy’s parent company), saw an average pay increase of 40 percent in the last four years; autoworker wages increased only 6% in that time, while inflation is up 18%.

Now, as their contract is set to expire, the UAW has been in negotiations with General Motors, Ford, and Stellantis, making reasonable but necessary demands:

* Fair pay increases
* Improved benefits and pensions
* An end to the tiered wage system
* And job security for all workers during the transition to electric vehicles

Auto workers, like every other working person, need wages that keep up with the cost of living. They need to know that their jobs will be there as the industry changes. For an industry that’s made nearly $250 billion in profits over the last ten years, auto workers deserve their fair share for the value they create.

Show your support for auto workers as they take their fight to the next level. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/uaw-petition?contactdata=Cs1EGQKyKNHL280dlwtwwCj0wIJ+RWfvLUVJ+Cd8Gp4/GtMG7LR4BwEpdEvTfg58zZfZmGLs8KRwBjAjAeDnOuv/aoaNyFJbU9ifrtko5YRWyHGm99MjFzq0suurmMGY1lta8cvK9g3gCbpdBHTGsg==]

In solidarity,
Ro

subject: Take a stand for border security
body:
Joe Biden and his administration have spent the past two-plus years ignoring the border crisis.

| |

| |

Friend, Joe Biden and his administration have spent the past two-plus years _**ignoring**_ the border crisis.

Frankly, we've all heard preposterous claims from the Biden administration that _" the border is secure"_ - even when the reports and numbers have proven otherwise...

Whether it's reports that the government has lost track of 177,000 migrants inside the U.S., the announcement from NYC that it will cut overtime pay for cops to help pay for the migrant crisis, or stories that the number of migrant families crossing the U.S. border illegally have reached unprecedented levels...it's clear we have a crisis on our hands.

I want every American to understand my dedication to creating a safe and secure border. Even further, I want them to know _EXACTLY_ how I plan to do that when I'm in office. **Here are the actionable items I will start out with:**
* Recruit and hire new Border Patrol and ICE agents to stop the flow of drugs and illegal immigrants!
* END catch-and-release and START catch-and-deport!
* Restart Remain in Mexico and Title 42!
* Defund sanctuary cities!
* Institute a national E-Verify program, just like I did as governor of South Carolina!
* End taxpayer-funded handouts to illegal immigrants.

name: Tim Burchett
subject: A Note About Honoring The Victims Of 9/11
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Burchett for Congress**
body:
Where was Joe Biden this week?

| | | |
---
| |
---
---
| | Friend, September 11, 2001, will always be known as one of the darkest days in American history. 2,977 Americans lost their lives in the 9/11 terrorist attacks—changing our nation and its people forever. It’s still difficult to come to grips with what happened that day. An unfathomable act of evil was carried out right here on U.S. soil, and for those of us who witnessed the horror unfold in real-time, we will never be the same. It’s a wound that never heals. Where was President Biden on the 22nd anniversary of 9/11? He marked the occasion in Anchorage, Alaska—more than 4,000 miles away from Ground Zero. For [the first time](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=fdfb5ca89b1343d09064a8271b058af8&_e=-sLPSjsLXsTdA4LlIqu4RULrm7n5u4fruascmGmA6IlyaFO1VSRMdRz_s6EEo8nxBU1SGgKoSIWVeau1T5zaD_ztQ1Z44ZaQXGMp8gAcVenXbDewwN4I-IHcOtpfNmUXoTJwTSAD0luQHBQfoXwU_bHpKY55RZUAGyuW2zghUoW0d08_BmWwt7D46J3XrF1ZkXyapYCPmfZ82PD1iu-qYaPr2u-tO3hyChxDf8ePiV36txFjwjMsdh2RdEBUzXHcBh725TNWXJFePI00cHnvRA%3D%3D) since this horrific incident took place, a sitting president did not commemorate the tragedy at one of the attack sites or from the White House. To make matters worse, his remarks included [odd jokes](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=fdfb5ca89b1343d09064a8271b058af8&_e=-sLPSjsLXsTdA4LlIqu4RdE7ZNLtFvhzEkP-MyHZIIT_eLCk3-fO7YjtvJInpFHR2dbSKiXBvLgPnuA7It4VDKS21Ta2TxXSdK_sae4Y0pGahjSDEUnkrLiH5E5O6ZYpLYulbtIAvbHhGX6m0wmg5UqTUw6gAzQZ1YHfZ15CRnZflz628ClkvT4FIKanVkjb-AJXWGSFj0RjoGK6f-5GXx1m62uGcWHylwWXSlCAr1mCRH6hCeYYvi-cm_fUMR7ha_s5qMYaX5ktYIDhy8QHSkYaToiz86WFRWqWmpYc0_k%3D) and [false claims](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=fdfb5ca89b1343d09064a8271b058af8&_e=-sLPSjsLXsTdA4LlIqu4RT56f2kvEB8MBEfsdiYoXGTA7v-3tjGeR-FzWbSTdXE19m73dhBA_PFTta0zegOQLEthmgwGnGF9ksHHAByjoqbVOsC4U_ujlOVC-5TLturBHUig1Q4OymP8saT78VKc8xSUhMtWZAAO_baxtIYxIwlW7-9Nn7G1zNRsh0i8q1N2XXwZJwkjLztN3TNs6Z2pnGmekf6tl8vOEvJKh0HqCWd7t5b3rDuVgHYxiVE5H4wKG7EAfbB3cqh0qqhApBNZMySzQm9elr_LY4SlJPc4HDo%3D) that he was at Ground Zero ‘the next day’ after 9/11. Of course, he and his staff have their [laundry list of excuses](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=fdfb5ca89b1343d09064a8271b058af8&_e=-sLPSjsLXsTdA4LlIqu4RdE7ZNLtFvhzEkP-MyHZIIQABzy4KfXFJ6EGD6lgq6IolnTWbQ43zQ-KN3opw3JNNZunCHgPTdc8HaNdX66q8VZMHup6_Qe5C-AQW1iTNMQIAXT83wZ8P-Q8u221XP0FuB56eeOQ5V7LWkBJDurWG7BBBBBVMEcisY4f8RzsqBBxnkDlZ_dXN4lS_HBxlhzhGLVR5eEGFjK6ygEqY1KnuAa2Eqlw1zoUurEkz9W_fzn0gpx3mFmWjbOPMbcN7gFnfabUq0--3qw0e1qpkZBXqYGQOtf7zbmqj2cVGNTi_qp6) for his absence, but none of them add up. The victims’ families deserve to hear directly from the leader of the free world on this day _every single year_. It should truly be a drop-everything-else type of moment. It was an honor to attend the [annual stair climb](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=fdfb5ca89b1343d09064a8271b058af8&_e=-sLPSjsLXsTdA4LlIqu4RTzRlgUEx9Ng0eZ3BbgF-bPygqKMoKCQV18Yrmt6qI3seLKJqpvBss78ibjWLf6R4Yj5foFJ7-MtKP8tecshgYXfTzZ_feEbLS1NEsGc_g2e8pBSSvBib94zPikY9eiSixc-9Bt2A-xa8EC2Rr2mEAIif4W_s5ODxRktBqQBcB9gnYDoF-3w_KaQzqBduqubr3r8-1umiymcC3yVmfPskdBREgfoikeM5AotA0MZ19-8CbxAu3A_dwGsRTOUUCl0uw7J58YBasVBT-nSoIOqKDqpMLpPe1gTn6LoL7XSeCIF) at the Sunsphere in Knoxville as we remembered the sacrifices made by our brave first responders. | Peter, if there’s one thing you need to know about our Senate race, it’s that **MAGA Republicans see no greater threat to their power than yours truly.**

Just look at how they’ve reacted in the last seven months since we announced this campaign:

As soon as Kevin McCarthy had scraped by in the Speaker election — with a bare minimum number of votes after his _fifteenth_ humiliating attempt — **he removed me as the top Democrat on the Intelligence Committee.**

**Introducing legislation to bar me from receiving classified information.

Censuring me in political retaliation for investigating and impeaching Donald Trump.

Even trying to fine me $16 million.**

* Soliciting and using Russian help in the 2016 election
* Leveraging his office and U.S. military aid to Ukraine to get Zelenskyy to smear Joe Biden

VanValkenburg Phone Bank
The Newsletter [https://slack-imgs.com/?c=1&o1=ro&url=https%3A%2F%2Fmobilizeamerica.imgix.net%2Fuploads%2Fevent%2F1_20230908151415960480.png%3Fw%3D1200%26h%3D628%26fit%3Dcrop%26bg%3DFFF]
TODAY: 9/13
Join the Freedom Virginia team and VanValkenburg campaign for a phone bank in support of Del. Schuyler VanValkenburg!
In 2017 Schyuler wanted to further his career of public service: so he ran for Delegate to serve Virginia and Henrico County. Now, after six years in the House, he’s ready to take his service to the State Senate.
In the Senate, he is ready to continue to advocate for meaningful investments to improve our public schools, introduce legislation that will attack the gun violence epidemic in our communities head-on, and work harder than ever to open economic opportunities for all Virginians.
Click here to sign up via Mobilize!
Sign up here [https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/579892/]
Phonebank for Kannan Srinivasan - HD26
[https://mobilizeamerica.imgix.net/uploads/event/4_20230911174602995760.png?auto=format&crop=faces&fit=crop&h=494.24083769633506&w=944] Tuesday, 9/19
Join us as we get out the vote for Kannan Srinivasan for Virginia House District 26!
As a finance and business leader, Kannan helped grow a small technology insurance business in Sterling into an industry pioneer that created thousands of jobs. He serves as Chair of the Virginia Medicaid Board—appointed by Governors McAuliffe and Northam—he also sits on the Board of the Loudoun Free Clinic, and has been a tireless advocate for healthcare access in our county and the Commonwealth.
Click here to sign up via Mobilize!
Sign up here [https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/580438/]
Education Town Hall with HD97 Candidate Michael Feggans
[https://mobilizeamerica.imgix.net/uploads/event/2_20230910212647598342.png?auto=format&crop=faces&fit=crop&h=494.24083769633506&w=944] Thursday, 9/21
Join Freedom Virginia and HD97 Candidate Michael Feggans In the Virginia Beach Town Center for an Education focused Town Hall
Education is key to a progressive Virginia. Education is a key issue for Democrat Michael Feggans in his exciting race for House of Delegates in Virginia Beach. Come out in support and hear the views of this exciting candidate. Light refreshments provided.
Click here to sign up via Mobilize!
Sign up here [https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/580282/]
Pizza and Postcarding
[https://mobilizeamerica.imgix.net/uploads/event/1_20230911170211701097.png?auto=format&crop=faces&fit=crop&h=494.24083769633506&w=944] Monday, 9/25
Join Freedom Virginia and Together We Will Loudoun for a family-friendly pizza and postcarding event!
Kids can wear their PJ's and bring pillows/blankets/stuffies to enjoy a movie night while parents help encourage voters who don't often come out for off-year elections to get out and VOTE! Staying the whole time is not required, come and go when is convenient for you. Please register for yourself and your kids so we know how much pizza to bring!
Click here to sign up via Mobilize!
Sign up here [https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/580403/]

Visit our site [https://freedomva.org/]

subject: Take a stand for border security
body:
Joe Biden and his administration have spent the past two-plus years ignoring the border crisis.

| |
---
| |

Friend, Joe Biden and his administration have spent the past two-plus years _**ignoring**_ the border crisis.

Frankly, we've all heard preposterous claims from the Biden administration that _" the border is secure"_ - even when the reports and numbers have proven otherwise...

Whether it's reports that the government has lost track of 177,000 migrants inside the U.S., the announcement from NYC that it will cut overtime pay for cops to help pay for the migrant crisis, or stories that the number of migrant families crossing the U.S. border illegally have reached unprecedented levels...it's clear we have a crisis on our hands.

I want every American to understand my dedication to creating a safe and secure border. Even further, I want them to know _EXACTLY_ how I plan to do that when I'm in office. **Here are the actionable items I will start out with:**
* Recruit and hire new Border Patrol and ICE agents to stop the flow of drugs and illegal immigrants!
* END catch-and-release and START catch-and-deport!
* Restart Remain in Mexico and Title 42!
* Defund sanctuary cities!
* Institute a national E-Verify program, just like I did as governor of South Carolina!
* End taxpayer-funded handouts to illegal immigrants.

Welcome back to our Team Liz weekly update.
