| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

body:
You may have heard about Bidenomics, but what does it really mean?

[](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ac66a2d889fd47c38349474435b6cd67&_e=56QeyHEFXdGheT6BHq98e7-JpykNKQGvMQze0HmNeXLjRf5xJCBcBUhPSJ1866PVNNXsavYStgyBkAsR_HLKooVKLTW6xWfNG7Lr-C73EUCgLuxESVE6vJhkMruyqFfnMAesPn6-KM7-Ap3eLubpJIMNiDvToXYUoJEJYg5PSPlf-IYMPr0YNDy0kx4KzMwDn9DQF-CrScdgtU5z-OZ47YGdHyiawaJ4yFsVlBT_LHcsI-CQ_9znRITEU4RhSRNVmzycN155J5TY64EVT4TkoA%3D%3D)

Friend,

You may have heard about Bidenomics, but what does it really mean? More importantly, what does it mean for the taxpayers and for our country?

**Bidenomics hasn 't increased jobs or decreased unemployment.** It's because people were going back to work after a once-in-a-generation pandemic. Bidenomics didn't decrease deficit spending by doing anything, either. The deficit is still a huge problem, and _many of Biden's policies have made it worse_.

What Bidenomics has brought us is -
* Rapid inflation due to the printing of money and more federal spending.
* Americans taking on a record amount of credit card debt.
* Families falling behind on their car and house payments, along with rising interest rates.

**This administration has not done a good job of looking out for middle-class Americans, and neither has Congress. **

I am Al Canata, Vice President of Strategic Partnerships at the National Taxpayers Union (NTU). We are the "Voice of America's Taxpayers." Our mission is to achieve favorable, pro-taxpayer policy outcomes using the most effective team on Capitol Hill and in the states.

My goal is to raise $20,000 before the end of the week to convince Congress to stop pushing Bidenomics on our country as lawmakers come back to Washington from their recess. [Your generous support helps NTU expose the issues with Bidenomics. Please click below to donate $10, $35, $50, or even $100 today.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ac66a2d889fd47c38349474435b6cd67&_e=56QeyHEFXdGheT6BHq98e7-JpykNKQGvMQze0HmNeXLjRf5xJCBcBUhPSJ1866PVNNXsavYStgyBkAsR_HLKooVKLTW6xWfNG7Lr-C73EUCgLuxESVE6vJhkMruyqFfnoiaRD5wi3-AyioW5P3vWS8DR2YW09SLGMf2oy_e_icPGkznAfu6YJxDUrhpzcj6D6eVxOIiVGBb1cZEbwPtlUD-yfu_VbPFqKiQZ16lQjFcTb3IgYXcZXpqRmie3TjbvXtXgcInakHpxfJl6hWlbsw%3D%3D)

[Donate >>](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ac66a2d889fd47c38349474435b6cd67&_e=56QeyHEFXdGheT6BHq98e7-JpykNKQGvMQze0HmNeXLjRf5xJCBcBUhPSJ1866PVNNXsavYStgyBkAsR_HLKooVKLTW6xWfNG7Lr-C73EUCgLuxESVE6vJhkMruyqFfn76ASxVWrND6HaTxmb0SCG5e075wH2INdq2ePdnqoK3ppPFDjz1TbyxoYHV1EtrTZXh_LeqrjLwRWFpkBY11LRCe-5KNVFN1KM8ufu5HjOsncIP3nd3kHScqL_66KWTuoNT0HLYmPrviL8AfAyf4M2A%3D%3D)

**Bidenomics is just another way to make people poor, and making people poor is not the best way to fight inflation.**

They are trying to combat inflation by destroying demand. The philosophy there is if people don't have money, they can't go out and buy stuff, which will reduce demand, and prices will fall.

If we keep seeing aggressive action from the Fed in the form of raising interest rates, things will only get worse.

**The Federal Reserve could cause a consumer debt spiral that leads to mass bankruptcies that could lead to a full-scale recession!**

Even though there is no easy solution, we need better responses out of Washington, D.C.

name: Majorie Dannenfelser
subject: Let our lawmakers know you stand for life!
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWySAm0DNK

I'm writing to you today as a passionate protector of vulnerable
women and the unborn....

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWySAm0DNK

Pro-Life Advocate,

I'm writing to you today as a
passionate protector of vulnerable women and the unborn. I know
that you share my belief that every human life is precious and
should be protected.

I've been a pro-life activist for
over 20 years, and I've seen firsthand the devastating effects of
abortion on women, children, and families. I've met women who
have had abortions and dealt with the pain and regret as they
navigate a deeply felt loss in their lives. I've met children who
were born after their mothers were denied an abortion and who are
now thriving. And I've met families who have been torn apart by
abortion.

I know that you're also aware of
the recent Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. This
is a historic victory for the pro-life movement, but this was
just the beginning of the fight. We still have a long way to go
to ensure that all unborn babies and their mothers are protected
from abortion.

The first step is for pro-life
Americans to come together and state what we believe and what we
will do in order to protect the unborn. Will you join me in
standing up for the rights of unborn children?

When you sign the pledge, you'll
be joining a growing movement of pro-life Americans who are
working to make a difference. You'll also be receiving regular
updates from SBA Pro-Life America about the latest pro-life news
and events.

SIGN THE PLEDGE »

I know that you care
about the unborn, the protections for mothers and their babies
and I know that you want to make a difference. I hope you'll join
me in signing the SBA Pro-Life America Pledge to Stand Up for the
Unborn. Together, we can build a pro-life America where every
child is welcomed and valued.

For LIFE,

Marjorie Dannenfelser
President, Susan B.
Anthony Pro-Life America

Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America

PO Box 803
Arlington, VA, 22206

name: Katie Porter
subject: The child care cliff + why you should care
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
This will affect our entire economy.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=29794%2E3422442%2EAWXYPP)
[](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/kp4s_em_20230913-child-care/?source=EMAL13_1_CHIL_20230913_V1_F&t=2&akid=29794%2E3422442%2EAWXYPP)
**In 2021:** Congress made big investments in child care during the pandemic, allowing parents to head _back_ into the workforce after we saw women _leave_ the workforce in record numbers.
**On September 30th:** That funding is set to expire, and if Congress doesn’t act, an estimated 70,000 child care centers will close.
**The result:** Millions of parents will likely reduce their hours or leave jobs altogether, and our economy is slated to lose **$10.6 BILLION.**
Investing in child care isn’t just good for families. It’s good economic policy, and I’ve never met a voter who doesn't want a strong, stable, globally competitive economy. But Republicans are standing in the way of passing additional funding to keep families afloat and our economy stable—threatening a government shutdown at the end of the month rather than investing in programs Americans rely on.
[**Can you sign our petition and join me in pushing Congress to prioritize funding child care?**](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/kp4s_em_20230913-child-care/?source=EMAL13_1_CHIL_20230913_V1_F&t=3&akid=29794%2E3422442%2EAWXYPP)
[Sign the petition ›››](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/kp4s_em_20230913-child-care/?source=EMAL13_1_CHIL_20230913_V1_F&t=4&akid=29794%2E3422442%2EAWXYPP)
As a single mom of three who knows how tough it can be to find reliable child care, this issue is also personal. For too long our government hasn’t invested in child care, allowing child care costs to rise faster than nearly anything else.
We’re reaching a pivotal moment and I’ll keep fighting for adequate funding.
Thanks for reading,
Katie Porter

Dear Fellow Conservative,

I’m reaching out today with a quick reminder of a hard-hitting message that my team and I continue to share on news media, on Capitol Hill, and online:

**Socialism is the wrong prescription for Americans who want quality, affordable health care.**

If you believe this as I do, please don’t delay in submitting your opinion to be considered in urgent debates over socialized health care and your medical coverage.

You know the facts: that the Left’s extravagant “Medicare for All” plan would rob Americans of their choices, increase healthcare costs and end Medicare as we know it.

If you are frustrated by politicians who think more government is the answer to every problem, and who want to put your healthcare choices in the hands of Washington bureaucrats instead of your own doctor, we need your help today to stand firm against socialized healthcare.

Please use the link below to submit your opinions in our Ballot on Socialized Healthcare:

**[[Submit Your Ballot]](http://trk.libertyledger.-A)**

Heritage is the conscience of conservatives on this key issue — reminding them that they campaigned on promises to fight big government and that they now MUST follow through on their promises to you and all U.S. taxpayers by fighting socialized health care.

To fight socialism, we must expose the costs and dangers of government-rationed health care. So please don’t delay. Submit your ballot today:

clean_body: | | Please see a special message from our sponsor. | | | | Dear Fellow Conservative, I’m reaching out today with a quick reminder of a hard-hitting message that my team and I continue to share on news media, on Capitol Hill, and online: Socialism is the wrong prescription for Americans who want quality, affordable health care. If you believe this as I do, please don’t delay in submitting your opinion to be considered in urgent debates over socialized health care and your medical coverage. You know the facts: that the Left’s extravagant “Medicare for All” plan would rob Americans of their choices, increase healthcare costs and end Medicare as we know it. If you are frustrated by politicians who think more government is the answer to every problem, and who want to put your healthcare choices in the hands of Washington bureaucrats instead of your own doctor, we need your help today to stand firm against socialized healthcare. Please use the link below to submit your opinions in our Ballot on Socialized Healthcare: [[Submit Your Ballot]]() The facts make it clear that one-size-fits-all, government-run health care is wrong for America. Heritage is the conscience of conservatives on this key issue — reminding them that they campaigned on promises to fight big government and that they now MUST follow through on their promises to you and all U.S. taxpayers by fighting socialized health care. To fight socialism, we must expose the costs and dangers of government-rationed health care. So please don’t delay. Submit your ballot today: [[Submit Your Ballot]]() Best regards, Kevin D. clean_body: | | Hello, Every day, we see new stories about censorship in our public schools and attacks on teachers, librarians, and students. The book banners claim they're protecting our children, but they're actually taking away their freedom to speak, to ask questions, and to earn. Fortunately, across America, regular folks are starting to organize to protect our freedoms. = | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will be processed immediately. | = | = | = | = | = | = I strongly believe that in 2023, with no presidential or congressional races on the ballot, the most important elections in America will be for school boards. The extreme right is investing heavily in these races because it’s threatened by our public schools’ mission of teaching critical thinking and facts, and to energize MAGA voters for bigger races down the road. But most Americans – Democrats and Republicans – oppose book banning and censorship. If we mobilize around this issue now, we will win this year, and be ready for 2024. = | = Thank you for supporting what matters, Tom Malinowski * | Districts for Democracy will work one school board, legislative, and congressional district at a time to recruit and support candidates committed to freedom of inquiry, thought, and speech for everyone. We want to keep the culture wars out of our schools, return school board elections to their nonpartisan roots, and keep our schools and universities focused on their central mission: helping our kids become educated and engaged citizens of these United States. = = Paid for by Districts for Democracy Districts for Democracy P.O. name: Sara Jacobs
subject: Back to school means back to lockdown drills.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Students all over the country are waking up earlier, packing their backpacks with fresh school supplies, adjusting to their new classes - and likely participating in their first active shooter drills of the school year.
I can remember the first time I learned how to hide from potential shooters in a lockdown drill: ten years old and crammed in the corner furthest from the classroom door, all of us sitting in silence - and fear. Because even though it was a drill, the recent Columbine shooting was fresh in our minds.
Those images traumatized our country, and the kids of my generation and every generation afterwards practice their drills each school year because it’s the only thing they can do.
In our unwillingness to take action, we’ve left our children to fend for themselves.
Every year that we’ve failed to adopt meaningful solutions to these issues, more children have been killed in schools and grocery stores, at parades and festivals and parks, in their places of worship and in their homes.
Enough is enough. No child should live in fear of getting shot, killed, or traumatized by gun violence. If you agree, please join me by adding your name to this petition demanding action. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/H1ofl5td9E-8c9rb-OuP-A2?contactdata=ubiiLL5cDa09u7OdoD/zODeAL0YCrwHVyhgyARUJnjXNs6s/eC7ZlY3wPJA5nr3wEJ5ePYcB7DjjNnlXgOezSI1z24DeU1FOrAvAKDHlH0M3AtUEOHLOsW2fHNobkOWm/tWS8Qy7IyavvQoEcq/5OQ==]
There are real solutions and steps we can take - but first we have to call out our complacency and self-interest. We’ve allowed the NRA’s propaganda to seep into our collective consciousness - normalizing our pain and dissuading us from taking action in the name of personal liberty. This gun violence crisis isn’t normal at all - it’s a uniquely American experience, with the U.S. gun homicide rate 26 times higher than that of comparable countries.
For children, gun violence is especially deadly. Since 2021, gun violence is the leading cause of death for children and adolescents - surpassing those caused by car crashes, drug overdoses, and cancer. That is unimaginable and unacceptable.
Children dying by gun violence is a policy choice - one that too many of our elected officials continue to make over and over again. Too many elected officials still live in the pocket of the gun lobby, unwilling to take even the smallest steps to protect children out of fear they lose out on campaign contributions or get challenged in their next race.
Until we take real action, the epidemic of gun violence will continue to get worse, and we’ll keep hitting devastating milestones, like the fact that more than 500 people have been killed in mass shootings this year - the most at this point in at least ten years.
We need to take action by banning assault weapons, strengthening background checks, and passing red flag laws. Please join me by adding your name here. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/H1ofl5td9E-8c9rb-OuP-A2?contactdata=ubiiLL5cDa09u7OdoD/zODeAL0YCrwHVyhgyARUJnjXNs6s/eC7ZlY3wPJA5nr3wEJ5ePYcB7DjjNnlXgOezSI1z24DeU1FOrAvAKDHlH0M3AtUEOHLOsW2fHNobkOWm/tWS8Qy7IyavvQoEcq/5OQ==]
One more thing: This inaction, this cowardice, this loyalty to the gun lobby? The truth is, it lies squarely with the GOP. It’s not just “elected officials” refusing to save lives - it’s Republican elected officials. So while we push for bipartisan action right now, we also need to prepare to do everything we can to take back a Democratic majority next year. I hope you’re with me.
Thanks so much.
-Sara

Since I announced my candidacy this summer, I’ve heard a few variations of this question:
“You don’t really expect to win as a Democrat in _Utah_ , right?”
So let me be absolutely clear: **I am in this race to win, and I’ve got a track record of winning tough fights.**

I won a Republican-leaning district on the Utah State Board of Education in 2016. I had never run for office before, but I was determined to make sure my state’s education policy incorporated the views of people who’ve spent years in the classroom.

I saw up close on the Board of Education how the legislature’s extremism and one-party rule held up progress and hurt working Utahns. So in 2018, I ran for State Senate to cut through the theatrics, end the gridlock, and actually solve the problems facing our families. Utah Republicans _really_ wanted to hold this seat; they worked hard to try to undermine me, but our people-powered campaign won out and defeated a sitting incumbent.

I learned first-hand in these early campaigns just how important the voices of everyday people are, and just how powerful they can be. **I won before on the strength of grassroots donations, and I’m aiming to do it again.**

Pundits are ready to write off any Democrat in a federal race in Utah. But I can tell you: folks here are sick and tired of what MAGA Republicans like my opponent have to offer.

They’re ready for a leader who will fight to protect individual healthcare decisions. A leader who will fight to protect our classrooms from government overreach. A leader who will fight to protect our environment and stand up to the corporate interests that are polluting our air and water. A leader who will stand firm on the side of compassion when politicians threaten to cut Social Security and Medicare.

Every day on the campaign trail, I’m making the case to Utahns in the 2nd District why I’m that leader. But I can’t do it alone.

**[So I’m asking: will you split a contribution between my campaign and Jennifer Wexton's today? Every bit of support matters as this race heats up!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69672091/426912280/516561914?refcode=EM_FR_230913KR_N_KR_FULL_14_NG_N_L2&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxM2FkOGE2MS01ODUyLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=a9l_SoqM580YIq11Isyq7llLbCdxRjQN9USpQrlR5E0=)**

Voters go to polls on November 21 – only 69 days from now! = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately and be split between Kathleen Riebe and Jennifer Wexton: | | = | | = | = | | = | = | | = Since I announced my candidacy this summer, I’ve heard a few variations of this question: “You don’t really expect to win as a Democrat in Utah , right?” So let me be absolutely clear: I am in this race to win, and I’ve got a track record of winning tough fights. I won a Republican-leaning district on the Utah State Board of Education in 2016. I had never run for office before, but I was determined to make sure my state’s education policy incorporated the views of people who’ve spent years in the classroom. I saw up close on the Board of Education how the legislature’s extremism and one-party rule held up progress and hurt working Utahns. So in 2018, I ran for State Senate to cut through the theatrics, end the gridlock, and actually solve the problems facing our families. Utah Republicans really wanted to hold this seat; they worked hard to try to undermine me, but our people-powered campaign won out and defeated a sitting incumbent. I learned first-hand in these early campaigns just how important the voices of everyday people are, and just how powerful they can be. I won before on the strength of grassroots donations, and I’m aiming to do it again. Pundits are ready to write off any Democrat in a federal race in Utah. But I can tell you: folks here are sick and tired of what MAGA Republicans like my opponent have to offer. They’re ready for a leader who will fight to protect individual healthcare decisions. A leader who will fight to protect our classrooms from government overreach. A leader who will fight to protect our environment and stand up to the corporate interests that are polluting our air and water. A leader who will stand firm on the side of compassion when politicians threaten to cut Social Security and Medicare. Every day on the campaign trail, I’m making the case to Utahns in the 2nd District why I’m that leader. But I can’t do it alone. = Thank you, Kathleen_ Paid for by Wexton for Congress Wexton for Congress PO Box 650550 Sterling, VA 20165 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please .

Commissioner John King got his start as a beat cop with the Atlanta Police Department. He worked various assignments, including Red Dog and Organized Crime, before joining the Doraville Police Department. Before becoming Chief of Police, he served as a Detective and Deputy Chief.

During his 17 years as Police Chief, Commissioner King tackled corruption, implemented community policing in at-risk neighborhoods, and cracked down on gang violence through early intervention programs at local schools.

In addition to his career in law enforcement, Commissioner King spent four decades serving in the U.S. Army National Guard — enlisting as a private and retiring as a major general.

He deployed to Bosnia, Iraq, and Afghanistan — earning the Bronze Star Medal, Combat Infantry Badge, El Salvador gold medal for achievement, meritorious service medals, and a NATO award along the way. Commissioner King retired from active duty in 2023.

As Georgia’s Insurance and Safety Fire Commissioner, Commissioner King has disrupted the status quo, put Georgia families first, and held the powerful accountable. He was appointed by Governor Brian Kemp in 2019 and elected to a full term in 2022, making him Georgia’s first Hispanic statewide elected official.

body:
This is Fox's latest attempt to deflect any attention away from Donald Trump.
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1555%2E120351%2EQnJftm)
Peter,
Yesterday, news broke that House Speaker Kevin McCarthy will open an impeachment inquiry into President Biden as early as this week, calling it “the next logical step.”
Here's the thing, Peter — there is nothing logical about pursuing an impeachment inquiry **_without a shred of evidence**_. And privately, Republicans themselves said they have no real reason to impeach Joe Biden. But Fox News is going all-in on this impeachment story, so we need to step in.
We'll go into depth about why and how Fox News is playing a central role in this looming impeachment, but if you don't have the time, **[can you chip in $5 to help our network of nine newsrooms combat Fox News' disinformation machine?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230913?refcode=em20230913&amount=5&refcode2=1555_120351_QnJftm&akid=1555%2E120351%2EQnJftm)
The real reason behind this bogus impeachment attempt is part of a larger disinformation crusade by Fox News and other right-wing propaganda networks to deflect any and all attention away from Donald Trump’s growing legal woes _and_ to boost their own ratings and revenue.
Moreover, McCarthy is worried about the future of his job. His sudden urge to impeach the president (after a non-stop drumbeat from Fox) shows the powerful grip Fox and its hosts have on the GOP and its leaders.
In return for driving this sham impeachment inquiry, McCarthy is attempting to appease MAGA Republicans like Marjorie Taylor Greene and others to shore up his own political support in a bid to keep the speakership and maximize GOP fundraising ahead of the 2024 election.
Peter, we're not surprised by any of this. Distracting from Trump's very real legal issues by making up a sham impeachment for Biden, all while boosting their ratings has been Fox News' plan all along. **But we're fighting back.**
Rather than chasing profits or publishing overly sensational headlines, our network of newsrooms and our reporters are laser-focused on making good information freely available in the spaces where misinformation thrives to push back against misleading, dishonest content in real time, correcting the record whenever and wherever we can.
**But standing against one of the largest disinformation machines in the country isn't cheap, Peter. We rely on grassroots supporters like you, pitching in what they can, as they can, to power our honest, impactful journalism.**

subject: TAKE ACTION: Show your support for auto workers

body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

The United Auto Workers (UAW) are on the verge of launching one of the biggest strikes of the year, with nearly 150,000 workers calling for fair wages and better working conditions.

Let’s show the UAW we have their back–sign here to stand with auto workers and their families as they prepare to fight for the respect they deserve. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/uaw-petition?contactdata=hbpnMtHxd8h/fVnMrNZyt37NUK0zFFw25HUt2/iTSnML9zJRaClo88qXghUD8WNJXzqTFY+zMNfwf6oLXWYVoq15X2UaxDjUM+85psT169BK0O684XhgENpNkplYIo2iEAtC+JR78ZJlmjr96dVgAA==]

Sign the Petition [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/uaw-petition?contactdata=hbpnMtHxd8h/fVnMrNZyt37NUK0zFFw25HUt2/iTSnML9zJRaClo88qXghUD8WNJXzqTFY+zMNfwf6oLXWYVoq15X2UaxDjUM+85psT169BK0O684XhgENpNkplYIo2iEAtC+JR78ZJlmjr96dVgAA==]

Over the past fifteen years, it’s become harder and harder to make a career in car manufacturing. Newer hires are making significantly less [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-autos-usa-families/for-uaw-members-two-tier-wage-issue-is-personal-idUSKBN0OI0C420150602] than their coworkers for doing the same job under a tiered labor system. While jobs were cut in the wake of the Great Recession, remaining employees have been forced to work 60 to 70 hours per week [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2023/aug/21/uaw-big-three-automakers-union-contract-negotiations] and lost their pensions. Job security is on the line in new manufacturing jobs. Meanwhile, the CEOs of Ford, General Motors, and Stellantis (Chevy’s parent company), saw an average pay increase of 40 percent in the last four years; autoworker wages increased only 6% in that time, while inflation is up 18%.

Now, as their contract is set to expire, the UAW has been in negotiations with General Motors, Ford, and Stellantis, making reasonable but necessary demands:

* Fair pay increases
* Improved benefits and pensions
* An end to the tiered wage system
* And job security for all workers during the transition to electric vehicles

Auto workers, like every other working person, need wages that keep up with the cost of living. They need to know that their jobs will be there as the industry changes. For an industry that’s made nearly $250 billion in profits over the last ten years, auto workers deserve their fair share for the value they create.

Show your support for auto workers as they take their fight to the next level. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/uaw-petition?contactdata=hbpnMtHxd8h/fVnMrNZyt37NUK0zFFw25HUt2/iTSnML9zJRaClo88qXghUD8WNJXzqTFY+zMNfwf6oLXWYVoq15X2UaxDjUM+85psT169BK0O684XhgENpNkplYIo2iEAtC+JR78ZJlmjr96dVgAA==]

In solidarity,
Ro

Peter, Is there anything I can say to convince you to chip in $5 ahead of our final mid-month deadline before end-of-quarter? What if I told you our team relies almost entirely on donations we receive from folks like you to fund our work? What if I mentioned that our plans to elect more women and young people in 2024 are already in the works? body:
My report on the 2023 RNC Summer Meeting and Presidential Debate in Milwaukee Wisconsin, plus the next YAC meeting has been scheduled!
| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001DQ3R_QT5p1Ee_WNhgXQtV8sbRUjFYrVaQAIYu_hQY4qqK_m8FPzZgf-cYu0Q8tZo637xfAv6u5REbuG6gTKCMNuEyRfGYOOYSYszaNBvfO6c9bmetplG6JyYU5m7cOUBfnp7w9xD11M=&c=jWfOJSY5E4Zmp4IxTMsOk5X9JoR5fan_YtTsJkacJfDMVKkox4W03Q==&ch=ozHdz0pJnZZnLg4WgIuvIrG48hagjqdUDJ9oYD9HqBRXViHsBJlB-A==)
---
---
| Friend,
First I would like to apologize for the delay in my report to you all. Following the trip to Milwaukee I caught the China Virus again and was down with that, then had a conference for my elected position on the Pleasant View Water and Sanitation District Board of Directors in Keystone, CO.
I am pleased to be writing you today to provide my report on the RNC Summer Meeting in Milwaukee, WI!
The Summer Meeting was a great success. I was thrilled to be in attendance with many of my fellow members of the Youth Advisory Council including, Co-Chair's CJ Pearson and Brilyn Hollyhand, Members Riley Gains, Benji Packer, Sunjay Chawla, and Tom Joannou.
We are all committed to working hard on behalf of our generation to secure their votes as we lead into 2024 and the following elections and I am excited to continue to work with them every step of the way.
Many important resolutions were adopted by the Republican National Committee during their General Session on the last day of the Summer Meeting.
A major resolution that was adopted was the "RESOLUTION URGING A "RETURN TO EXCELLENCE" IN AMERICAN VOTING AND ELECTIONS" brought forward by Tyler Bowyer, National Committeeman from Arizona.
I encourage you to read this resolution and the full list of proposed and adopted resolutions at the Summer Meeting by clicking the button below.
---
| | [View the Resolutions Here!](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001DQ3R_QT5p1Ee_WNhgXQtV8sbRUjFYrVaQAIYu_hQY4qqK_m8FPzZgUCfM6Ca2QFirvp2Y3vg3wzCMKTqQoTvV-gN7EkcZ3C-tljeGiM1Co1u1iPkOMnd_4ieU0afNoGHTudBXtCMyWIeLiFL55q8Wl60Wj3yiDspxXtwmr-j45bG06MaOWqqzg5hDfBjrvuOutLFDdiRu1FCU_LF51EvEsU57ykg2yWUbDUCcYgMJBk=&c=jWfOJSY5E4Zmp4IxTMsOk5X9JoR5fan_YtTsJkacJfDMVKkox4W03Q==&ch=ozHdz0pJnZZnLg4WgIuvIrG48hagjqdUDJ9oYD9HqBRXViHsBJlB-A==)
---
| While we were in Milwaukee, the host city for the 2028 Republican National Convention was announced and adopted by the Republican National Committee.
It is important to note that State Chairmen Jeff DeWitt of Arizona and Dave Williams of Colorado raised the issue to the committee of not hosting the Convention in a swing state and or a western state with the continued push to the left in our western states.
At the end of the discussion, all but one vote was cast in favor of Houston, TX becoming the host site as proposed for the 2028 National Convention.
After General Session it was incredible to attend the signing ceremony with the Houston Host Committee and RNC Chairwoman Ronna McDaniel in Milwaukee.
To learn more about the 2028 National Convention click the button or image below.

clean_body: My report on the 2023 RNC Summer Meeting and Presidential Debate in Milwaukee Wisconsin, plus the next YAC meeting has been scheduled! | | | | == | Friend, First I would like to apologize for the delay in my report to you all. Following the trip to Milwaukee I caught the China Virus again and was down with that, then had a conference for my elected position on the Pleasant View Water and Sanitation District Board of Directors in Keystone, CO. I am pleased to be writing you today to provide my report on the RNC Summer Meeting in Milwaukee, WI! The Summer Meeting was a great success. I was thrilled to be in attendance with many of my fellow members of the Youth Advisory Council including, Co-Chair's CJ Pearson and Brilyn Hollyhand, Members Riley Gains, Benji Packer, Sunjay Chawla, and Tom Joannou. We are all committed to working hard on behalf of our generation to secure their votes as we lead into 2024 and the following elections and I am excited to continue to work with them every step of the way. Many important resolutions were adopted by the Republican National Committee during their General Session on the last day of the Summer Meeting. A major resolution that was adopted was the "RESOLUTION URGING A "RETURN TO EXCELLENCE" IN AMERICAN VOTING AND ELECTIONS" brought forward by Tyler Bowyer, National Committeeman from Arizona. I encourage you to read this resolution and the full list of proposed and adopted resolutions at the Summer Meeting by clicking the button below. | | == | While we were in Milwaukee, the host city for the 2028 Republican National Convention was announced and adopted by the Republican National Committee. It is important to note that State Chairmen Jeff DeWitt of Arizona and Dave Williams of Colorado raised the issue to the committee of not hosting the Convention in a swing state and or a western state with the continued push to the left in our western states. At the end of the discussion, all but one vote was cast in favor of Houston, TX becoming the host site as proposed for the 2028 National Convention. After General Session it was incredible to attend the signing ceremony with the Houston Host Committee and RNC Chairwoman Ronna McDaniel in Milwaukee. To learn more about the 2028 National Convention click the button or image below. | == | | == | Following the Summer Meeting the next Youth Advisory Council meeting has been scheduled and I am looking forward to attending it on Monday the 18th of September (Hopefully in person in DC!). name: Shamaine Daniels
subject: He doesn't give a damn. Do you?
body:
www.danielsforcongress.org [www.danielsforcongress.org]
Dear Friend,
Recently, Scott Perry has been making the rounds pretending to care about the people he represents. In case you missed it, it's been a complete embarrassment for all of us. Not only are Perry's priorities out of step with the needs of his constituents, he seems to forget that HE is the one who is supposed to be fighting for our community. Check out the video below (compliments of the West Shore Democrats)
https://www.facebook.com/westshoredems/videos/1677055582796821 [https://www.facebook.com/westshoredems/videos/1677055582796821]
There aren't too many people I would say this about, but Perry is absolutely shameless. He is right HE, the one who represents Harrisburg in Washington, has not done a damned thing about the challenges the residents of Harrisburg face.
If you want to show Scott Perry that YOU give a damn about the terrible job he is doing representing us, CLICK HERE to make a contribution to help us defeat Perry. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Between his local supporters who demolish homeless encampments, and his own failure to do anything about access to healthcare, affordable housing, the cost of prescription drugs, and income inequality, all while constantly sabotaging our government with coups or shutdowns, this man has not done a damned thing to help the residents of Harrisburg, or any other community in PA-10.
He refused rescue funds for the city, and opposed broadband infrastructure that would have benefitted every community in the district. When our homeless encampments were bulldozed, he was nowhere to be seen. When our walls/bridges collapse, he is nowhere to help. In fact, many question whether his office is even staffed because when residents need services from their Congressperson, all we hear from ours is crickets.
Are you ready to for a Representative in Congress who will fight to make the lives of all Americans better? A Congressperson who will actually be there to help people during crises, and invest in solving problems? CLICK HERE to support our campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Perry is right to be concerned about the opioid crisis and the deadly impact of Fentanyl. But instead of grandstanding for news cameras, Perry should be taking action to make addiction treatment counseling accessible. The waitlist for help with addiction in his District is ridiculous and he refuses to do a damned thing about it.
He could go after those who produce these deadly drugs, instead he scapegoats immigrants at the border, not the producers. Because frankly, when it comes to solving problems, he is just a coward blustering away in the hopes that he doesn't have to do a damned thing about them.
But the shamelessness here is just amazing, telling us how he has gone about winning election after election, without having to do a damned thing about the struggles his constituents face.
It is obvious that when it comes to really helping people, he is not interested in doing a damned thing about the challenges we face. So next November, it is up to us voters to do a damned thing about HIM.
CLICK HERE to make a contribution to support the campaign so we can fix the REAL problem . . . Congressman Scott Perry [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
P.S. If you missed my announcement video, you can check it out below.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQXcyDlej8Y [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQXcyDlej8Y]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/99379/images/PaidForByDanielsForCongressB.jpg]
Daniels For Congress
P.O. Box 60654
Harrisburg, PA 17106

They sure are piling it on with Governor Brian Kemp’s “Medicaid Unwinding” process, where over 2.7 million Georgians – most of them children – must requalify for Medicaid coverage. At risk? Kemp will protest and say he’s expanding Medicaid coverage, but guess how many applicants were enrolled in July? 265. | Fellow activist,

**Did you know September is National Voter Registration Month?** To celebrate, our staff is organizing exciting community events in all of our regions, from Allegheny to Philadelphia. Registering to vote is a celebration of democracy and voters deserve to have some fun! With 40 days until the voter registration deadline on October 23rd, it is all hands on deck to register voters within our centered communities in time to vote in the November General Election.

[**Will you help us fund these national voter registration events across Pennsylvania by donating $25 or more today?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/69684299/426933250/1465444750?refcode=EM_F_230913VR_N_TN_90DO_8_NG_N_L1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ4NDdhMGE3LTY1NTItZWUxMS05OTM3LTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=_XpTBLHFG8XquBziy85MnORKCvjPvbT5yZ0eUp60QT8=)

Ensuring that voters turn out this November and beyond is CRITICAL.

That’s why we have a plan:

**🎒SCHOOLS:** We are working to register high school and college students across the state. Low youth participation is disastrous for our democracy and young people alike, and there is too much at stake to sit idly by. That’s why we have launched massive campaigns to ensure this key demographic is engaged, registered, and ready to vote twice a year.

**👏 EVENTS:** NPP will be at events happening across the state, like football games or concerts, to ensure people know how to register to VOTE! We meet people where they are – out in their communities – to ensure they have everything they need to cast their ballots in November, and we have no plans to slow down.

**⚖️ COURTS MATTER:** We are spreading the message on social media, on the streets, and across the state of why #CourtsMatter. _“We see across the country how important state Supreme Courts have been in protecting our rights,”_ – our CEO, Kadida Kenner

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

I’m a 4th generation Texan, born and raised in Dallas by a single mom. My mom was a public school teacher and sometimes worked two jobs to make ends meet. Thanks to my family and a strong support system of teachers, coaches, and the good folks at the YMCA, I earned a full ride football scholarship to Baylor University and then went on to play in the NFL.

But playing football was never my only dream – from a young age I knew I wanted to help people. So I became a civil rights attorney to defend what I believe is our most fundamental right: the right to vote. I proudly served in President Obama’s administration before I came home to Dallas, where I’m now raising my family.

I ran for Congress because I wanted more kids in North Texas to have the opportunity to achieve their version of the American dream and protect the fundamental values of our democracy – and I beat the odds to defeat an 11-term Republican incumbent, helping Democrats flip the House blue in 2018.

Now, I’m ready for my next challenge: taking on Ted Cruz. I know it won’t be easy, but I also know that Texans deserve so much better than Ted Cruz’s cynical partisan politics. Everything Ted Cruz does is for Ted Cruz – when I’m in the Senate, everything I do will be to help people like you. But I can’t get there alone:

[**That’s why I’m asking you to chip in right now to become a donor of my campaign. Let’s do this,

_Colin Allred_

**ICYMI: Chris Christie: I'd Rather Have The Opportunity To Beat His Ass**
Last night at a town hall in Bedford, New Hampshire hosted by Tell It Like It Is PAC, special guest Chris Christie was blunt and direct like always.
When asked about whether or not the 14th Amendment bars Donald Trump from holding public office, Christie didn’t mince his words.
Watch the clip below:
[](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=1a063aaf99&e=d0a9afa930)
**CHRISTIE:** “I would rather have – let me finish the answer, a jury of his peers, or the voters decide that. Now, I don’t think that means he’s above the law, he’s been indicted four times, he should go to trial on those things. If convicted by a jury of his peers, he should be subject to the sentence that a judge gives him, and have to serve that sentence. So, I’m all for that. But I really do believe that where we are in this country and the divisions we have now, Quinn, if any court said Donald Trump could not be on the ballot, that you would cause such unrest in this country and division. I would rather have the opportunity to beat his ass, that’s what I want to do.”

Peter,

General David W. Allvin, nominated to serve as the 23rd Air Force Chief of Staff, appeared before the Senate Armed Service Committee yesterday to answer questions as part of his confirmation hearing.

General Allvin has served as the Air Force Vice Chief of Staff since 2020, and has an impressive resume. He has a wealth of strategy and planning experience, having served at U.S. European Command, the United Nations, and the Pentagon.

[**STAND WITH ME**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/c8e2774da8d4d6d3c3d6b838967d376c/33013/6a9db91cec957053/3e8edfb5a3ce64fec3d6b838967d376c/33013)

Friend, Over 3 million U.S. children could lose child care soon, because federal funding is set to expire at the end of the month. Last week, I hosted a roundtable with the congressional Mamas’ Caucus and leaders in our community to discuss the urgent need for Congress to invest in child care. Through the _American Rescue Plan Act_ , hard-hit child care providers received financial assistance to cover costs for providing care. **Without extending the funding past this month, 70,000 child care programs will likely need to shut down.** We can’t let that happen. [**Please add your name today to call on Congress to invest in child care and early childhood learning programs, before funding expires on September 30.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnlu-i6nB4VJ8K8Ns881jqWJVuq_w1MiuY5DcZODod3VtwOOvjSPLcPWdBJ0Iwb0BWBAK-Ps-WkUK8oQpHrl6bhI4SJdYdC2eB1eCE1M8rFocetgX0LlpjcIklaJ9lTI26gUHUnfwFa5u2n-De0B8laTYEdIWHOkZkigU-8VolW382289Ag2PabpxqH2lG7-UOoR1mJUe0eikwvwD-Ct5aK5I1CZGRmvcSEgObBvzzNL6kwekA9NJjZP-K3VXiKtpjJ1aZ8OOWeUGe1HjcqaFgwE53W0YzJXPr6tb8UQ3LxVQnXWRU0_YzxUflb1LBaN8tjYq7fRPnJE1VfCRwkV11fhZYCmirlRV8hHiMHBXT6yrHDf7UrxwgPrJqXewcXhBgYmUHp5DEEDl_H8fy-CJCNo67Zw5bZiMp5-ytizv3z4e01tI3ZvCDIJOsULVPqjKW_jY5CxVyZmLHzR2n0pZ40h/3zk/bWbeJXzHS-KaeO5hm2X82A/h1/0SVAPM9iF57JIJdtf5VBLqT4xFOkAyLFVnJ4QQfz7B4) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnlu-i6nB4VJ8K8Ns881jqWJVuq_w1MiuY5DcZODod3VtwOOvjSPLcPWdBJ0Iwb0BWBAK-Ps-WkUK8oQpHrl6bhI4SJdYdC2eB1eCE1M8rFocetgX0LlpjcIklaJ9lTI26gpLsfDewAQfqZfPmOvxcDyoLWuoY2T3sYxtXbD0taG7xoQpYtaqLNAO42s1Z2U1f22ZATcdBJiUCDKYDXUQwStypz02oNtj8EqwNhkJkgtT55b5ztAOnxnNu4Cmz90zAr4GjDvQ3atlcsJ_D3v__gV5BDBIzpSu7pTevHYDbAekajGZQEY_sX-GIF6VHewoAkTK_HkaaLPli_uTKuoJbxyXbNIAgP3x21yIdtrwmJ4qHhMhkFJiBdSSX2pw0c9f_g0fBXDnIvduKEvc3J_3bnJgKpN9JT3cEhzPwok_Ciwt6dzUa6WJ9ivN7z5irorwn95lNWA4YYNxBTkFgW7itEq/3zk/bWbeJXzHS-KaeO5hm2X82A/h2/3ww6amNYyh3Sd_NWrs8NAYV-7CHahaUcQzsS3fGPZiw)

Congress can pass emergency spending measures, and we also need long-term solutions, such as investing in child care and early childhood learning programs, ensuring decent living wages for workers, and getting families the resources they need to be able to afford child care.
We already have great policies in front of us.
**I co-sponsored two bills this year that would invest in child care and early learning programs:** the _Child Care for Working Families Act_ and the _Child Care for Every Community Act_.
I also introduced the _End Child Poverty Act_ to provide families with a universal benefit of nearly $400 per month, from children’s birth until their 19th birthday. This would provide more per month (and for more years) than the American Rescue Plan’s temporarily expanded Child Tax Credit, which helped families cover rising child care costs and cut child poverty by 40% before it expired at the end of 2021.
We have policy solutions, but we need to pass them through Congress and implement them.

In solidarity,
Rashida

name: Alexandra Rojas
subject: Just a handful of Bernie 2016 staffers and volunteers — including me.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, this email
will probably be a bit longer than others you receive today, but it’s
really important and I hope you’ll read the entire message.

Justice Democrats was started by just a handful of Bernie 2016 staffers
and super volunteers. We had just worked on this inspiring campaign for
president. Bernie put a progressive agenda front and center for millions
of people for the first time — myself included.

In 2018, when Justice Democrats recruited AOC to run, she was working as a
bartender — she even worked as a bartender for many months while running
for office. Sometimes, that’s what it takes when you’re a working-class
candidate.

We helped AOC manage her team, run her organizing program, and make
everything we could of our small budget. Then, she won. We toppled one of
the most powerful corporate Democrats and elected the youngest woman ever
to serve in Congress in his place.

Money has always been one of the biggest things holding us back from doing
more. It’s the one thing that our establishment opponents have a seemingly
endless supply of and that we’re always working hard to raise just a
fraction of what they can raise. The DCCC protects entrenched incumbents
who are out of touch with their districts — we’re working every day to
recruit and elect progressive champions who will fight for policies that
match the scale of the crises we face.

We don’t take a dime from corporate PACs or Wall Street, so we rely on
supporters like you to power our work.

In order to sustain our work, we’re counting on our grassroots supporters
to help ensure we have the resources we need and right now we’re working
overtime to reach our mid-month fundraising goal of $32,000 before
midnight on the 15th.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137987?refcode=em20230913-30838&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=30838%2E1203867%2E8v017q ]Will you contribute $3 right now to help us continue to
recruit and elect the next AOC or Jamaal and support our progressive Squad
in Congress?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137987?refcode=em20230913-30838&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=30838%2E1203867%2E8v017q ]Contribute $3

I know we can do amazing things together. I’m grateful to be in this fight
with you, thank you again.

In solidarity,
Alexandra Rojas, Executive Director

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1021&akid=30838%2E1203867%2E8v017q ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1022&akid=30838%2E1203867%2E8v017q ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20230913-30838-footer&t=1023&refcode2=30838_1203867_8v017q&akid=30838%2E1203867%2E8v017q

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. | | | **_Blah, blah, blah..._** **Sometimes, it seems like that’s all you hear on Capitol Hill.** _There’s a lot of talk, but no one is willing to do the hard thing and take action._ **That’s not my style.**

My name is Mike Waltz. I’m a Green Beret veteran, a retired Colonel, and an unapologetic conservative.

When I was out on the battlefield, we didn’t get anything done by talking. We acted and responded to threats as they came in.

_Members of Congress could learn a thing or two from America’s bravest._

Today, I’m asking you to stand with me and take action against the radical Left’s assault on our rights.

name: John Fetterman
subject: What Bob Casey and I DON’T have in common
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
We won’t win in 2024 without all coming together.
#
Hi Derek, it’s John. Or is it??
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230913-1?refcode=em20230913-1&refcode2=8558_434096_LXlstD&akid=8558%2E434096%2ELXlstD)
I might have fun with my Bob Casey cutout, but **Pennsylvania needs the real guy with me in the U.S. Senate fighting for working families.**
That’s why we’re holding a “Hoodies + Suits” fundraising drive (and I think you know which team I’m on). It’s so we can reach our upcoming $50,000 fundraising goal TONIGHT and do our part to keep the Senate blue 🔵.
**[So what do you say Derek? Can you split a donation of $5 or whatever makes sense for you right now to help support our team + my friend Bob Casey today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230913-1?refcode=em20230912-1-8558&refcode2=8558_434096_LXlstD&akid=8558%2E434096%2ELXlstD)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230913-1?amount=5&refcode=em20230913-8558&refcode2=8558_434096_LXlstD&akid=8558%2E434096%2ELXlstD)**
Even though we each have a prettyyyyy different sense of style, there’s way more that Bob and I have in common. He’s spent his career fighting the ultra-wealthy and special interests that threaten PA’s hardworking people. And because of it, he’s sure to face the same million$ in GOP money spent to defeat him that we did last year. Heck, he could even face more.
I couldn’t have gotten to the Senate without Bob’s support in 2022. And Bob won’t win in 2024 without help from all of us -- whether you’re #TeamHoodies or #TeamSuits.
**[So can you help us keep PA blue, defend our narrow Senate majority, and re-elect Bob with a split donation right away? We’re hoping to hit our $50,000 goal ASAP so we can fight hard to win.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230913-1?refcode=em20230912-1-8558&refcode2=8558_434096_LXlstD&akid=8558%2E434096%2ELXlstD)**
THANK YOU!
❤️ John
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator, Pennsylvania

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20230913-8558-footer&t=1&refcode2=8558_434096_LXlstD&akid=8558%2E434096%2ELXlstD)**

body:
I was told at some point: The only time you move to New York City is when you’re young or dumb.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69688908/426945968/872526041?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjN2IzMWVmYi02ZjUyLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=o3CavjVdJIKBrsoHyEY11VnjVBwZROx7_85DJ0FESR8=&emci=72e30cb5-6b52-ee11-9937-00224832e811&emdi=c7b31efb-6f52-ee11-9937-00224832e811&ceid=19445147)
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69688911/426945990/872526041?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjN2IzMWVmYi02ZjUyLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=o3CavjVdJIKBrsoHyEY11VnjVBwZROx7_85DJ0FESR8=&emci=72e30cb5-6b52-ee11-9937-00224832e811&emdi=c7b31efb-6f52-ee11-9937-00224832e811&ceid=19445147)
Hello,
I was told at some point: The only time you move to New York City is when you’re young or dumb.
I certainly had both of those things really covered when a friend of mine talked me into moving from Colorado to “the Big City” after we graduated so that he could chase a girl.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69688913/426945991/1610638071?refcode=em20230913pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=c7b31efb-6f52-ee11-9937-00224832e811&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjN2IzMWVmYi02ZjUyLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=o3CavjVdJIKBrsoHyEY11VnjVBwZROx7_85DJ0FESR8=)
Everyone seemed to want to hire someone who went to an Ivy League school – not the University of Colorado – so I ended up waiting tables for a while before I finally landed a job on the 100th floor of the World Trade Center.
By September 2001, I was working in Midtown, a few miles from the towers. But in the weeks and months that followed, I went to way too many funerals. And while living in NYC certainly made life interesting, I decided it was time to pause and do some reflecting.
It’s much harder to find good people than it is to find a good job. So I loaded up my beat-up old car and drove back to Colorado to see some friends – and get some hugs.
That’s how I ended up meeting a gal named Katy. Like me, she was a former ski racer and had a deep love of exploring the outdoors. The only word I could think of to describe her was “incredible.” And eventually, I worked up enough courage to ask if she wanted to make a go of it together.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69688915/426945993/1610638071?refcode=em20230913pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=c7b31efb-6f52-ee11-9937-00224832e811&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjN2IzMWVmYi02ZjUyLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=o3CavjVdJIKBrsoHyEY11VnjVBwZROx7_85DJ0FESR8=)
We decided the Western Slope of Colorado was the perfect place for us to create a community for ourselves and our future family. And Katy is _everything_ you could ask for in a wife, a mother, and a partner.
Katy somehow has found the time to do it all. She’s a successful businesswoman, serves on our local school board, was deeply involved in my race for Congress against Lauren Boebert last year... and even after all that, she still finds the energy to keep me in check when I need it.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69688930/426945995/1610638071?refcode=em20230913pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=c7b31efb-6f52-ee11-9937-00224832e811&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjN2IzMWVmYi02ZjUyLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=o3CavjVdJIKBrsoHyEY11VnjVBwZROx7_85DJ0FESR8=)
I didn’t know what I was looking for when I headed back to Colorado in 2001. But I found it all – and more – in Katy and our two children.
Tonight, as we celebrate our 20th anniversary, I am reminded just how lucky I am to have you in my life. I love you, sweetie.

clean_body: I was told at some point: The only time you move to New York City is when you’re young or dumb. Hello, I was told at some point: The only time you move to New York City is when you’re young or dumb. I certainly had both of those things really covered when a friend of mine talked me into moving from Colorado to “the Big City” after we graduated so that he could chase a girl. = Everyone seemed to want to hire someone who went to an Ivy League school – not the University of Colorado – so I ended up waiting tables for a while before I finally landed a job on the 100th floor of the World Trade Center. By September 2001, I was working in Midtown, a few miles from the towers. But in the weeks and months that followed, I went to way too many funerals. And while living in NYC certainly made life interesting, I decided it was time to pause and do some reflecting. It’s much harder to find good people than it is to find a good job. So I loaded up my beat-up old car and drove back to Colorado to see some friends – and get some hugs. That’s how I ended up meeting a gal named Katy. Like me, she was a former ski racer and had a deep love of exploring the outdoors. The only word I could think of to describe her was “incredible.” And eventually, I worked up enough courage to ask if she wanted to make a go of it together. = We decided the Western Slope of Colorado was the perfect place for us to create a community for ourselves and our future family. And Katy is everything you could ask for in a wife, a mother, and a partner. Katy somehow has found the time to do it all. She’s a successful businesswoman, serves on our local school board, was deeply involved in my race for Congress against Lauren Boebert last year... and even after all that, she still finds the energy to keep me in check when I need it. = I didn’t know what I was looking for when I headed back to Colorado in 2001. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

subject: To Prioritize Equity DHS Anti-Terrorism Funds go to Groups Devoted to Underserved Populations
body:
To ensure “equity is a key priority,” a Department of Homeland
Security (DHS) anti-terrorism program that annually doles out millions
of dollars to combat violence in local communities is awarding a
substantial chunk of funds to recipients devoted to underserved
populations, including a D.C. nonprofit dedicated to empowering
lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and questioning (LGBTQ) youth.

name: Rick Scott
subject: Why I'm running for re-election
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rick Scott for Florida
body:
| | | Friend, Late nights in the Senate, weekends meeting with Florida voters, and everything in between, I do to defend the state and country that I love. There is so much work to do to rescue our country from the disaster caused by the Biden Administration. We have to save our country, there is no other option.

I didn’t come from a lot. I grew up in public housing. My family lived paycheck to paycheck.

But there was love, faith, and a hardworking spirit that helped me throughout my life. And of course, my amazing wife and high school sweetheart, Ann, who I married at 19.
---
[](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=cf5d342bc24441cc91b79d6369e1517d&_e=FkBKBFW8zTLI5xK46wwAF7DSHgjSjeBfRvX2Y7QGlv_Onf11Zeo9eZZ8bSgpiunR9g4wV8fqV9E4RjZP8QdZaAryns3CcLPAjiTXIKfzREAMBFzHobYU7De1FY_8-BpM3OscyjoJiR4t3C7MvXb2tePRZCk5MzLIY6RHSGdei6seCJJLbhWYEjRRnqyyOig8ROMR6yQbKkP7mXM5AL9rOZHYwAZnATcJY2A_1elB4RqDpU8fvtABB2Fyz-Rc3Rp9OHOEbBdKetwHnK6DoZbgubE-JlPvH8ql17CBsJf-PBbZs3NWCnsWL35U7WIXp_Vi2_Y3n-EZrR1NNmakTxvdh_ZDWInV7BAtdoftMYhWU1vMhuFwopfdj71Pqh3xQk-LPiLgZpsXPLF-j51xaIb4ZQ%3D%3D)
---
My service to America started right after high school when I joined the Navy as a radar man aboard the USS Glover.
---
[](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=cf5d342bc24441cc91b79d6369e1517d&_e=FkBKBFW8zTLI5xK46wwAF7DSHgjSjeBfRvX2Y7QGlv_Onf11Zeo9eZZ8bSgpiunR9g4wV8fqV9E4RjZP8QdZaAryns3CcLPAjiTXIKfzREAMBFzHobYU7De1FY_8-BpM3OscyjoJiR4t3C7MvXb2tePRZCk5MzLIY6RHSGdei6seCJJLbhWYEjRRnqyyOig8ROMR6yQbKkP7mXM5AL9rOZHYwAZnATcJY2A_1elB4RqDpU8fvtABB2Fyz-Rc3Rp9zCE4GPnzNQwmKmAAAtNvP9qZKOEbcj0NUysy_AIxsmGo8AN3ubhAA5CpcnBqESm8eUkgB1_PsKNqc08zwhc4CRRRwsWrMCEzYZOboqUkfzZP_yNFaYu6YRLwbWUBF0kEWin9aEafmH_BtGX_1d5KKQ%3D%3D)
---
And when I bought my first business, a donut shop so my mom could have a job, I was so incredibly proud.

I look back on pictures of that business and I can’t help but be grateful to live in America. Only here can a kid from public housing go on to be successful in business and then be a United States Senator.

I’m so passionate about the American Dream because I’ve lived it, Friend. And, I want to make sure our future generations have the opportunity to live their version of the American Dream.
But right now, our freedoms face a massive obstacle; Democrats. Liberals want to take away our freedom and replace it with a system where government elites decide the winners in society. They want us to be dependable on the government, Friend.

But here’s the truth: With hard work, success is possible for EVERY citizen in the greatest country on Earth.

**[Now, we are all faced with a decision. Do we choose liberal policies or do we choose freedom?](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=cf5d342bc24441cc91b79d6369e1517d&_e=FkBKBFW8zTLI5xK46wwAF7DSHgjSjeBfRvX2Y7QGlv_Onf11Zeo9eZZ8bSgpiunR9g4wV8fqV9E4RjZP8QdZaAryns3CcLPAjiTXIKfzREAMBFzHobYU7De1FY_8-BpM3OscyjoJiR4t3C7MvXb2tePRZCk5MzLIY6RHSGdei6seCJJLbhWYEjRRnqyyOig8ROMR6yQbKkP7mXM5AL9rOZHYwAZnATcJY2A_1elB4RqDpU8fvtABB2Fyz-Rc3Rp9ei5g04JqHNNg2SLr7KdTtFFiR3ceCqbFGn6d1WSIdXJEz-1JgUPa3aDromd_tiNbBaIsBs0DXvNmIV8Hq5vhlbIzOOgqfJFFM4NBJsV1s6E9wmWMhsafvFaOZbttGlWpL34wK1WGco9k9Kn-gQ7CHw%3D%3D)**
**[If you choose freedom, can you join my team today to SAVE AMERICA?](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=cf5d342bc24441cc91b79d6369e1517d&_e=FkBKBFW8zTLI5xK46wwAF7DSHgjSjeBfRvX2Y7QGlv_Onf11Zeo9eZZ8bSgpiunR9g4wV8fqV9E4RjZP8QdZaAryns3CcLPAjiTXIKfzREAMBFzHobYU7De1FY_8-BpM3OscyjoJiR4t3C7MvXb2tePRZCk5MzLIY6RHSGdei6seCJJLbhWYEjRRnqyyOig8ROMR6yQbKkP7mXM5AL9rOZHYwAZnATcJY2A_1elB4RqDpU8fvtABB2Fyz-Rc3Rp9YGCe0UW8ZP6l5lzxOm-_srQoXNK1EY4x6T-MKB02QRgS9D9WATTZATId1nzLBV_D8Y1kz3KWya3BmOTNTTLv92sTEb71pO7sadfdOR4izZhtAe-MXH2MSnhDjRtOhmnrw3jLuiOsqMUr6CPa07G8Og%3D%3D)**

name: Jayapal HQ
subject: People over profits
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Big Pharma, and many other predatory monopolies like it, are determined to keep profits over people.
#
Peter,
Pramila is determined to lead with one theme in mind: people over profits. Yet Big Pharma, and many other predatory monopolies like it, are determined to do the exact opposite.
That’s why Pramila joined forces with Sen. Elizabeth Warren to call on the FDA to hold Big Pharma accountable for abusing the patent system to force patients to pay for more expensive drug treatments — despite the multitudes of cost-effective drugs being made available.
Peter, lowering drug prices has been a long standing battle of our progressive cause. And now it’s time to attack this issue at the root. **[Add your name to our petition to the FDA urging them to hold Big Pharma accountable for abusing the patent system to exploit patients for profits.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/hold_big_pharma_accountable/?source=em20230913-2914&t=1&akid=2914%2E420207%2EtfCuth)**
**[Add your name ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/hold_big_pharma_accountable/?source=em20230913-2914&t=2&akid=2914%2E420207%2EtfCuth)**
Presently, the FDA requires any brand-name drug company to submit patent information that covers drug products. But that system is being abused by Big Pharma giants. They rig the list with “sham” patents that end up blocking the introduction of generic drugs that come in at lower prices than their big brand names.
**In short: Big Pharma companies have more of an incentive than ever to list “sham” patents to preserve their monopoly status and keep drug prices high.**
**[Please add your name to our petition to call on the FDA and demand them to put people over profits, end the abuse of the patent system, and take the first steps to lower prescription drug costs for the American people.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/hold_big_pharma_accountable/?source=em20230913-2914&t=3&akid=2914%2E420207%2EtfCuth)**
Together,
Jayapal HQ

clean_body: Big Pharma, and many other predatory monopolies like it, are determined to keep profits over people. Peter, Pramila is determined to lead with one theme in mind: people over profits. Yet Big Pharma, and many other predatory monopolies like it, are determined to do the exact opposite. That’s why Pramila joined forces with Sen. Elizabeth Warren to call on the FDA to hold Big Pharma accountable for abusing the patent system to force patients to pay for more expensive drug treatments — despite the multitudes of cost-effective drugs being made available. Peter, lowering drug prices has been a long standing battle of our progressive cause. And now it’s time to attack this issue at the root. Presently, the FDA requires any brand-name drug company to submit patent information that covers drug products. But that system is being abused by Big Pharma giants. They rig the list with “sham” patents that end up blocking the introduction of generic drugs that come in at lower prices than their big brand names. In short: Big Pharma companies have more of an incentive than ever to list “sham” patents to preserve their monopoly status and keep drug prices high. Together, Jayapal HQ | | Email us: info@pramilaforcongress.com

I would like to official invite you to attend my** _Campaign Launch Event_** tomorrow, Sept. 14th, in North Las Vegas! Join me as we celebrate the end of a successful tour, and beginning of a successful campaign in the race for Nevada's 4th Congressional district.

The theme of my tour, and campaign, has been connecting with voters in every corner of our district! After speaking directly with fellow Nevadans across our state, I can say with confidence that **our people are now ready for a seasoned leader** to step up and represent them.

I want our people to know that my **_lifetim_ e of effective leadership** will work for them in Congress. The Democrats ruling our state are loyal only to **Biden & Left-wing special interests**, and their poor leadership has failed our people. As your Congressman, I will be a strong leader, **fighting for the American people as I have _my entire career._**

So come out and see for yourself! Our much anticipated **_Official Launch Event_** begins At 6:30 pm Thursday evening, and I'd love to share with you my plans to make Nevada great again.

It's time... **let's _Flip Nevada Red._**

| The funeral service for fire fighter, Mia Etherage, was somber, and at the same time inspirational. She was an amazing person who left the world better than she found it.
